aśeṣatāpaprāśamanam sadā vande apratighāti svecchāvikāsa amṛtakaramaulim tataḥ smṛtiḥ apohanaśaktir iti yadyapi kramaḥ tathāpi atha anubhavavidhvaṃse iti pūrvapakṣe satyaṃ kintu smṛtijñānaṃ ... iti siddhānte smṛtireva pūrvaprakrāntā na cet iti sūtritena prasaṅgena sūcitāt prasaṅgaviparyayād ātmeśvarasiddhau sā gītāsu sā eva prathamam upāttā svadarśane upapattir abhidhīyate sa hi pūrvānubhūtārthopalabdhā ... ityādinā arthau bhātaḥ pramātari ityantena ślokāṣṭakena kaścit brūyāt māstu smṛtir upapāditā kathaṃ sā upapadyate ekena tadupapattir ekena smṛter uktam anubhavatadviṣayābhyām ekatāparyantaḥ āveśaḥ turyeṇa smṛtāv viṣayatayā pṛthak na
bhātīti yogijñānenāpi parānubhavo na pṛthaktayā viṣayavat prakāśyate iti bruvatā pañcamena tadartha eva draḍhitaḥ smṛtyā pṛthagviṣayīkaraṇaṃ kālpanikaṃ na vāstavam iti uktam vikalpasya api tādātmyaṃ saptamena antyena prasaṅgataśca pāramārthikaikasaṃvittattva-
viśrāntir darśiteti tātparyam prathamam upoddhātaḥ ityabhiprāyeṇa āha jñānaprakaraṇena iti smṛtyādirūpaṃ svadarśane ghaṭate ity evaṃ vicāryatvena dhikriyate smin tena kriyāyāṃ upapade bhaviṣyati ḷṭ ayamarthaḥ smṛtyādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ svarūpaṃ nirūpayiṣyāmīti smṛtereva iti yasyāḥ pūrvopakrāntatā tasyā eva pratipādayitum icchan sarvathaiva aghaṭamānatvam prathamaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃbhavam āha anena ślokena granthakṛt tadvimarśaparispandasvabhāvaḥ ślokaḥ anantaraṃ nirūpayiṣyate iti kramaṃ dyotayati yamevaṃbhūtaḥ kramaḥ suspaṣṭaṃ kṛtvā siddhau hetutā sti tato ayaṃ kramaḥ āha pūrvānubhavakālaḥ smaraṇakālaśca yāvat bodhena na vyāptaḥ tāvat kathaṃ smaraṇam na niyatāv iti taddvāreṇa āyātaḥ iti nityaprakāśasvabhāvo yo bodhaḥ iti labdham yadi tadavinirbhāgena nubhūtavastusaṃbhavo na bhavet kathaṃ smaraṇam iti sarvākāratālakṣaṇaṃ svātantryam uktam yadāha bhaṭṭadivākaraḥ sarve nubhūtā yadi nāntaḥ tvadātmasātkārasurakṣitāḥ syuḥ vijñātavastvapratimoṣarūpā kācit na saṃbhavet tat iti yāvat prakāśarūpatvāparihāṇiḥ kasyacideva bhāvabhāgasya unmajjanā nimajjana iti bahuśākhe vaicitrye yad asya nityabodhasvabhāvasya ātmanaḥ svātantryam etad aiśvaryam anantaśākham iti yāvat sādhayitavyaṃ tat siddhyatīti yuktaṃ spaṣṭatvam

pūrvānubhūtārthopalabdhā parato'pi san vimṛśan sa iti svairī smarati apadiśyate pūrvānubhūta iti aśeṣakālānugataśabdena avatāritaṃ ityādinā maheśvaraḥ pratyagātmatāṃ bhāsayamānaḥ yad vivṛtir cinmayasya īśvarasyaivahi iti pratyagātmatādaśāyāṃ tathā anekakālatopacāra-
pacaryamāṇaḥ parato'pi smaraṇavartamānakāle saṃskāraprabodhadhāmani yato bhavati tad asya pūrvārthopalabdhṛtvaṃ vicchidyate tato bhavanāt hetoḥ tathaiva pūrvāparobhayakāla-
valambanaucityādāgatena sa ityanena vimarśanena vimṛśati tameva kasmād iti yataḥ sa svairī sadṛśādṛṣṭapraṇidhānādyapi hi tasyaiva svātantryāt parasparagalitāv api animagnāv api santau cidrūpe ca nimagnau cidrūpe sphurantam api adhikam iva abāhyam api parāmṛśataḥ jīvitam ity api yadāha divākaravatsaḥ dhyānādibhāvaṃ smṛtireva cintāmaṇis tvadvibhavaṃ vyanakti iti hetutayā dyotayati sa svairī maheśvaraḥ ucyamānavakṣyamāṇanyāyāt smarati ity etad vyavahārabhājanam iti anvayo'yam upapannaḥ tasmāt na cet iti pūrvasūtroktāḥ prasaṅgarūpatvena yuktaḥ teṣāṃ smṛtyādīnām iti kathaṃ bhavet bhavati ghaṭābhāvād aṅkurābhāva iti yuktaḥ prasaṅgarūpatayā ayaṃ vyatirekaḥ iti samastasya etatprakaraṇārthasya hetutāṃ dyotayan pūrvaprakaraṇena saha saṃgamitaṃ karoti iti pūrvānubhūtatvena sa iti ubhayakālasaṃsparśī atra iti prāṇapuryaṣṭakadehādau pūrvānubhūtārthāsaṃpramoṣarūpā smṛtir nāma vyāpāraḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ sa ubhayakālaspṛk kartṛtaiva ca vibhutā iti vṛttiyojanā kālayogo nāsti vyavahāraḥ parato'pi asti iti tadākṣiptaśca pūrvam api astīti tau kathaṃ bodhātmani yena parato'pi san iti sūtraṃ taddhṛtiśca paścād api iti pūrvānubhūtārthopalabdhā parato'sti iti vyavahāro viśeṣye nupapadyamāno āśliṣyati yathā satatavāhitvena āna.... tadhāmanyapi bhūmaṇḍale mahad āścaryaṃ satatam api idaṃ pravahat kṛtayugocitaśāstravyavahāraṃ bhūmaṇḍalaṃ tiṣṭhatīti iti bhavedevam yadi viśeṣaṇaṃ kālavyavahāraṃ saheta naca sahate etad āśaṅkamānaḥ pariharati vivṛṇoti saptamyā anūdyamānasya anūdyamāne ca hetutayā ātmano nityatvam arthāt ākṣiptaṃ mantavyam bodhaikarūpasya api ceti nipātadvayena ubhayaniṣṭhaṃ pūrvapakṣāt vyavahāraṃ kathaṃ samarthayeta nyāyyaṃ ca etat kālavyavahārasya loke avaśya samarthyatvāt asaṃbhāvanādyotakaṃ arthānubhava eva iti na bhramitavyam bodhena te iti tathā iti svarūpādavibhaktā api bodhasvātantryaprakāreṇa āpāditāḥ ata eva bhinnā bodhācca anyonyaṃ ca tata eva deśakālaviśeṣaṇā ye arthāḥ yaḥ uparāgaḥ tena hetunā aham ity antarmukhatayā iva aham ity evaṃ bahirmukhatā api avabhāsate anubhavaśca tadīya eva nīlabodha iti bodhasvātantryāt nīlaṃ paśyeyaṃ tāvad iti antaḥkalpanāpūrvakaṃ bāhyanīlāvabhāsanam tatpūrvaṃ ca antaḥkalpanam arthoparāgād deśakālau pramātāraṃ ca āviśantau lakṣyete iti hi tritayam api bhāti

śaṅkitaṃ pūrvapakṣam hetutvena upajīvati bhavantau saṃvedanam āśliṣyataḥ kā bhāṣā āha apica asya anantaraṃ yadyapi artho viṣayaḥ tathāpi prakāśamānatākhyā prakāśam anupraviśataḥ iti prakāśo nayā naca tanmukhaprekṣitayā yena deśakālocitaṃ śambaram ujjhantī satī bhāseta kintu veśyayā iva māyāprabhāveṇa kurvatyā yena so'pi na na darśayati natu anubhavitṛrūpatā arthasya pratiṣiddho'pi vaktavyavastuśraddhayā kṛtaḥ samāse hi vṛttipadārtho pāṃsur iva udake tatkāluṣyarūṣaṇāṃ tatra naca atyantamalākṣaṇiko'yaṃ śabdaḥ yena apaśabdatvād kāpuṣkalatvakathā vaktavyasya sūtrāpekṣāt jātivācakatvāt ityādeḥ kvacit
iti śiṣṭaprayukte sārvatrika iti tṛjakābhyām iti niṣedho navakāśaḥ syāt iti kuto niścayaḥ āha māyāpadam avadyotitataraṃ syāt bhartṛīśvarācāryastu śeṣaṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya na niṣedhaḥ iti nyarūpayat ity etat viparyāsayitum kramo bhedāśrayo bhedo'py iti vakṣyate ayamarthaḥ ghaṭa ityatra ābhāsanasya avicchedaḥ saṃbhāvanāvicchede anubhavaḥ tadanubhavo dvāram atra sa eva yāvat na kālena spṛṣṭaḥ tāvat kriyāntaranibandhano'pi na bhavati iha tu sākṣādeva asāv upakrāntaḥ iti mukhyaḥ kālasparśo vaktavyaḥ viṣayasya natu yuktaḥ tiṅantavācye viśrāntaḥ kālo nirbhāsate tad etad aṅgīkārapūrvakaṃ kathaṃ tarhi tvayā uktam saṃvedane deśakālau ity āśaṅkya āha na etāvad etat anyo'pi asti viśeṣaḥ sa praśnayogyaḥ taṃ darśayati yadyapi kālaprathāyā bījam na asāv antarmukhena tathāsarūpatāyās tatra bahirmukhaṃ ca asya rūpam jñeya-kāryarūpam arthameva bhavatīti tātparyam cidrūpasya prakāśamātraikarūpasya ādyantavyavahāro na upapadyate prakāśābhāve tasya asiddheḥ prakāśābhāvāyogāt yathoktam natu yo'ntarmukho bhāvaḥ tasya lopaḥ kadācit syād iti lope sati upalambho na saṃbhavati iti sa lopa eva kathaṃ vyavahāryaḥ? iva udāsīnaprāyaṃ yuktaṃ paricchinna-
prakāśatvena nīlādivad acidrūpatāprasaṅgāt yathoktaṃ mayaiva paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila jaḍādvilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate iti svātantryam aham iti pratighātaśūnyo vimarśaḥ sarvaśaktitvam antarvyavasthitam api cinmātrarūpaṃ svaśaktiprapañcamayaṃ svataśca anyonyataśca vibhaktam iva nirbhāsatāmiti amunā api rūpeṇa prakāśamānaḥ svātantryāpratighātāt ucyate śaktiḥ tasyāḥ padaṃ viṣayo pramātṛprameyarāśirūpaḥ māyāviṣaye bhagavataḥ saṃbandhinyāḥ kartṛśakteḥ kālakramāvabhāsanaṃ
nāma vyāpāraḥ natu śuddhasaṃvinmātratve tadavabhāsanam yaḥ kālakramo idaṃ bhātaṃ na bhāti bhāsiṣyate ity ādir bhūtādirūpo bhāvānām anyonyāsahabhāvena tattvasya yad avabhāsanam itthaṃ vimarśanam apratihataṃ amunā api rūpeṇa itthaṃ prakāśeyeti vyāpāraḥ kartavyaṃ yasyāḥ sā kālotthāpakatvāt kālaśaktir iti ucyate avyāhatakalāṃ yasya kālaśaktim ityādau sopānapadapaṅktyā svātantryaśaktir avarohantī etena pramātṛprameyarāśinā ahaṃ prakāśe ity evaṃrūpatāṃ prāptā artharāśau karmaṇi kṛtapadabandhā avabhāsayati smaratīti ity evaṃprāyeṇa kriyātmanā prathate kriyātmā pratibhāsamānaḥ kālaśaktirūpeṇa anuviddha eva bhāti pūrvasya rūpasya jīvakalpasya avaśyaṃ sphuraṇāt kevalam apradhānatayā tasya
prathanam iti viśeṣaṇatvam upasarjanatvāt kālākhyayā śaktyā yaḥ samutthāpitaḥ asahabhāvo nāma kramaḥ tena bhūtādikālānuviddhā

sṛṣṭir kartṛśaktiśca kathaṃ sṛṣṭikramā kriyā syāt naitad āśaṅkanīyaṃ yasmāt kartṛśaktireva avabhāsanā svātantryādeva hi bhagavato bhāvāḥ sā ca avaśyaṃbhāvinā nirūpyamāṇā kriyeti ucyate tatsvātantryaṃ nirūpyate bhagavān aham iti antārūpāt icchāśaktāveṣaṇīyatvena sphuṭatayā parāmṛśyatvena śrīmatsadāśivabhuvi bahīrūpatayā idam iti avabhāsayitum icchati naca sā asya icchā apitu tathā prakāśayati evam asahabhāvaprakāśanāt kramikā avabhāsanā yataḥ tena sā kriyeti ucyate etadeva kumbhakaraṇaṃ tadapica icchopakramatvena kramikatāprathanam vakṣyate iti itthaṃ tathā ghaṭapaṭādy tiṣṭhāsor evam icchaiva kartṛtā kriyā iti etadeva karaṇam yat parameśvarasya tathā avasthānaṃ na anyat bhagavato nanyatvāt anubhavanirmāṇalakṣaṇam paramārthāhantārasapratyayamayyā idantayā bhāsanaṃ yāvat smaraṇarūpam apīti anusarati asyaiva iti sarvaśakticittattvameva kramikatayā tāṃ darśayati tamaḥpaṭalena avacchādita iva pratyagātmarūpe saṃvittattve yaḥ sthitaḥ pūrvānubhūtaḥ prāktanaprakāśaparāmarśarūpayā idantayā upalakṣito'rthaḥ tasya tamo'pasāraṇena sphuṭīkaraṇaṃ tatra yā icchā saiva upakramaḥ yasyā bahir iti tata eva vedakāt pṛthagbhāvena yo'dhunā vimarśaḥ sa yataḥ militaḥ tataḥ sa-ity evaṃrūpeṇa
śabdena āviṣṭaḥ ubhayakālasparśitāyām api prakāśate natu na prakāśate so avasānaṃ paryanto yasyāḥ sā smṛtikriyā api bhagavatkartṛkaiveti antarbahirbhāvo mantavyaḥ natu īśvarasadāśivaśivāpekṣayā yā viśvasya sphuraṇe smṛtir niyataviṣayā sā kathaṃ syāt na smaraṇam yaḥ prācya eva prakāśaḥ bodhasya bahirmukhatā tasya tamasā avacchāditasya iva apramoṣaṇaṃ nātyantam apahāraṇam iti tatrabhavadanantabhaṭṭārakādiprayuktaṃ ghañam tyaktvā lyuṭi ka ādaraḥ ata eva hi napuṃsakatvamasya siddhatādharmayoge'pi madhyamapadaviśrānteḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇapadavat iti kuto ayam asya viśeṣaḥ rūḍheḥ iti kartary api hi tṛjādivad ākhyātaṃ
vidhīyamānaṃ sādhyamānatāṃśaṃ pradhānīkaroti tathāhi avyayakṛtāṃ tadyoge kṛtvor'thaprayoga ityādi nirṇītaṃ paramaguruṇā patañjalinā kṛdabhihitaḥ ityatra dravyavat kriyāvat ceti etat bahutaraguṇavimardavaicitryavat vibhajanīyam iti alam avāntareṇa

na prakāśitaṃ rūpāntaraṃ ca asya prakāśitam tarhi na viṣayīkṛtaṃ tat śuktikārajatapītaśaṅkhādipratyayeṣu iva śuktikāśaṅkhādi jñānasya ca grāhakameva svarūpam iti tadaprakāśane grāhyabhāvasya ca prakāśane tat na viṣayīkṛtaṃ bhavet viṣayīkṛtatve hi niyamena vyāptam vipakṣe ca aniyamaḥ prasajyate iti tatsvarūpaprakāśenaiva vyāpyate iti vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ vṛttau na dṛśo darśanāntare iti sautraṃ na vivṛtaṃ pūrvamuktatvāt svātmārūḍhā eva iti evakāreṇa tu sūcitam svātmāruḍhatvena avabhāse parajñānaṃ prakāśitam iti paravyavahāraḥ katham aupādhikatvenetyāha ekasmin hi yogisaṃvedane parasya śarīrapraṇādi grāhakābhimataṃ nīlādi grāhyābhimataṃ rāgādicaittarūpaṃ jñānaṃ ca paramārthagrāhakarūpaṃ samameva nirbhāsate tatra aucityāt jñānaṃ grāhakabhāgatādātmyāpannam api pramukhaparigṛhītaparasaṃmatadehādyupādhisaṃbhedārūṣaṇayā paratvena vikalpyate gṛhyate tu svatvenaiva śarīrādi tu paratvena svāhaṅkārapṛthagbhāvena bhavati niyatiśaktyaparikṣayāt gṛhyate ca vikalpyate ca

vivṛṇoti tattvaṃ ityarthaḥ iti na upakrāntaṃ tat kathaṃ pratyavamṛśyam ity āśaṃkāṃ vyapohati sarvajñagrahaṇaṃ parātmavedakaparyāyatāmeti yogī samāviśyate tarhi sukhaduḥkhasahasrasaṃbhedavyatikarakalitaḥ sa saṃsāribhyo'pi kaṣṭāṃ daśām āśritaḥ yadāha idameva hi naḥ sukhaṃ yat sātaṃ saṃvedanam iti sa taddharmabhāk bhavati jalāntaram tathāca bodhāntarair iti svabhāvahetuḥ viruddhayā vyāptam ataddharmavattvam iti vipakṣāt pracyāvakaṃ pramāṇam atra pratikṣipati cakāraḥ ekamātrapadābhyāṃ sukhāder adhikasya grāhyabhāge eva viśrāntim āha tathāca sukhādīn prakṛtiguṇāneva vakṣyāma iti avāstave buddhipramātari teṣām avasthānam na paradehadharmair gauradibhir asya gauro'ham iti niyatiśaktyā niyantraṇāt śyāmo'ham iti tathā parabuddhidharmair vakṣyate sa svarūpāparijñānamayaḥ ... ityatra na vāstave pramātari sukhādi iti yaduktam tat vakṣyamāṇo'pi hetur upayukta iti evaśabdo adhikaraṇasiddhāntatām āha heturapihi adhikaraṇasiddhānta ucyate eva ye uttīrṇāḥ tatra te kathaṃ tathā bhavanti āha vāstavaṃ pramātāraṃ samyak dṛḍhaniścayaparyantaśuddhavidyāprakāśabalena ye āpannāḥ prāptāḥ pramātṛtābhimānabhājaḥ teṣāṃ nityoditam apica tadrūpaṃ cakrabhramavat dhṛtaśarīraḥ iti śeṣavartanasaṃbhāvanāt niyatisaṃskārajadehādipramātṛbhāvāvarohaṇātmake pratyastamitam iva bhāti iti daśāśabdena vyavahṛtaṃ sukhaduḥkhādīnām avaśyaṃbhāvinīmutpattim āha tacca taiḥ sākṣātkriyate anyagrāhakavat saṃvedyate upacacāra ca sā kṛtimāninī munim anargalabhogasamarpaṇaiḥ paritutoṣa ca so'pi virāgiṇāṃ nahi sukhaṃ karaṇāśrayiṇāṃ sukham iti sākṣātkāre apitu ahaṃ sukhīti pramātari sukhānuvedhamaye nābhimanyate tata eva anugraham upaghātaṃ ca sukhaduḥkhakṛtam abhimanute bhagavatā gītam duḥkheṣvanudvignamanāḥ sukheṣu vigataspṛhaḥ iti iti tadabhāve tadabhāva iti darśitaṃ harṣāmarṣabhayakrodhairmukta ... iti anugrahopaghātau cet na saṃvedyeta tarhi bāhyo ghaṭaḥ sukhādyātmā api yathā udāsīnasya na sukhaduḥkhamohātmā tathā buddhigatam api sukhādirūpaṃ na sukhādyeva syāt sukhādirūpatāvirbhāvasya hi anugrahopaghātau lakṣaṇaṃ anyathā anavarataṃ sarvaḥ sukhaduḥkhaparītaḥ iti tadvyāpakarūpābhāve tadanāvirbhāvaḥ iti ekāntaḥ satyam paramārthapramātṛtāsamāpannasya api dehāhaṃbhāvasaṃskāradārḍhyād aṅge'ṅgāraspṛṣṭe dāhakṛtaṃ buddhau duḥkhaṃ madhyoditavyutthānasamayasaṃbhavadrūpam api tadbuddhigatāhantāsvasaṃvedanasākṣātkṛtavimṛṣṭarūpam api saṃmukhīkṛtasatyapramātṛbhāvābhimānaviśramodrekāt vikalpyamānatātmakena dṛḍhaniścayātmanā anubandhena ahaṃ sukhīti yato na ahaṃbhāge viśrāmyati viśrāntyabhāvāt evaṃ hi pāntha iva mārgagatāṃstāṃstān sukhaduḥkhahetubhūtān yadṛcchopanatān na anubandhena rāgadveṣāyatanatvena abhimanyate tata uktaṃ ye tu dehādau saṃskāradārḍhyaṃ śithilīkṛtyaiva kuto'pi nibandhanāt gṛha iva adhikaraṇamātrābhimānena sthitāḥ teṣāṃ dehabuddhyādāv ahaṃbhāvalakṣaṇo yaḥ nugrahopaghātāvirbhāvako hetuḥ sukhādīnām āvirbhāvakaḥ sa nāstīti candanādisparśayoge'pi tadahaṅkārābhidhānasahakāryasaṃbhavāt sāmagrīrūpasya hetoḥ apūrṇatvāt na utpadyante eva sukhaduḥkhādayaḥ yathoktaṃ vāsīcandanakalpānāṃ vairāgyaṃ nāma ... iti vāsī candanakalpā yeṣāmiti guruṇā vyākhyātam iti śrīlakṣmaṇaguptagurur āha karaṇapreraṇādisvātantryameva vilupyate tat hi nahī cchānodanasyāyaṃ prerakatvena vartate apitvā tmabalasparśāt puruṣas tatsamo bhavet iti nītyā ahantāveśakṛtameveti kāraṇānupalabdhyā avasīdedeva satyamevaṃ kintu sahajasya akṛtakasya svātmaviśrāntilakṣaṇa samastapūrṇatodayāpākṛta vyatiriktākāṅkṣākā luṣyacidrūpasya paramānandasya yataḥ āvirbhāve nirāvaraṇatayā prakāśo bhavati tatastad ānandadugdhāmbudhinimgnā asau viṣayajanitasukhādisaṃvedanakaṇikā na pṛthag ātmānam uddarśayati śithilīkṛtadehādyahaṃkārāṇām vāstavapramātrāveśadaśāyāṃ yadivā tadeti sukhaduḥkhotpādāvasare yo lokasya tatra tatra te hi saṃbandhe sāvadhānatā ityupadeśabalena svarūpavimarśadraḍhimani viśrāmyantaḥ parānandena yujyante yathoktam ānande mahati prāpte dṛṣṭe vā bāndhave cirāt ityādi duḥkhe'pi ca vikāse'pi sthairyārthaṃ dhṛtisaṃgamāt ityādi ca niyatayogyāśayena vyavasthitavikalpārtho mantavyaḥ

prathame prakāre vedyavedakatāṃ nirasya jānātīti ityatra api smṛtitvaṃ ghaṭayan nirasyati pūrvasmin janmaviśeṣe anvabhūvam iti ātmārohaḥ siddha eva vyavahārācca smaraṇameva itthaṃ pūrṇam iti bhāvaḥ parakīyapūrvajātiṣu saṃskārasākṣātkaraṇopadeśābhyāsena yat yogino vijñānaṃ tatra pūrvānubhavasparśād abhinavajñānarūpatā uktā yogino hi yasya ityādāv iti avirodhaḥ dvitīyaṃ prakāraṃ smṛtau praveśya tṛtīyam api tathā karoti yadā kenacit pramātrā ghaṭo dṛṣṭaḥ yoginā tu pūrvaṃ na dṛṣṭas taduttarakālaṃ yogī taddṛṣṭatāmeva udrecayan bhāvanābalāt paraḥ paśyatīti anubhūtaviṣayāsaṃpramoṣarūpatvameva vikalpanāvasare taditipūrvadṛṣṭatayaiva hi vikalpayati na punar apūrvatayā jānāmīti mayā jñātam iti punarunmīlitaṃ pramāṇīkuru natu tatpūrvaprakāśatādātmyapraveśa eva hi tasya yoginas tadānīṃ smartṛtā tata eva manvādīnāṃ dharmaviṣaye prakāśanam api sārvajñyāt bhavat parameśvarasya anāder ayam itthaṃ prakāśa iti tatprakāśapramāṇīkaraṇena bhavat smṛtir ucyate pramāṇaṃ śrutiḥ yadanubhūtaṃ tat cet yogī smarati tat pramātrantaraṃ sa ca iti ekaṃ saṃpannam tataśca tena idaṃ dṛṣṭam iti kathaṃ vyavasthā āha svo yaḥ pratyagātmā dehaprāṇādiḥ tatra yo'hantādārḍhyasaṃskāras tasya anivṛtteḥ paraśarīrādi paratvena paśyati yataḥ tato vyavaharati iti yasya tu yogino dṛḍhaḥ saṃskāraḥ kṣīṇaḥ natu sarvātmanā naṣṭaḥ nāśe hi tasya saṃskārasya īśvara eva satu īśvarāyate nāśonmukhe tu tasmin sarvaprakāravati dṛḍhe saṃskāre aham iti paśyann api tanmadhya eva viśvam aham iti paśyati tad asya cakravartina iva viśvam anuśāsato'pi svadehādikam vedyatāṃ yogisaṃvedanāpekṣayā nirākṛtya upasaṃharati sthitam iti asyaiva pakṣasya dārḍhyam abhidadhat pakṣāntaram abhyupagamavādamātram smṛtyanubhavayostu tathāpi na vedyavedakatā ityāha asmaduktaṃ vedyoparāgādi parāsyati prātisvikena iti jñānasvalakṣaṇātmanā tat nirdiśati svasmin svasmin darśane yādṛśaṃ bodhasya śuddhaṃ rūpaṃ tat yathā sarvārtharūpatā śuddhir jñānasya nirupāśrayā tato'pyasya parāṃ śuddhim eke prāhur arūpikām prabhāsvaram idaṃ cittaṃ prakṛtyā āgantavo malāḥ citiśaktir apariṇāminī apratisaṃkramā darśitaviṣayā śuddhā cānantā ca guṇānāṃ samavāyāṃśopādhityāge paraṃ vapuḥ asaṃsṛṣṭam anirbhaktaṃ śuddhaṃ tattvavido viduḥ ityādi na tādṛśaṃ niruparāgaṃ vedyatāṃ paracittajñāne iti bhāseran iti ubhayatra vṛttikṛt darśayan bhānti ityasya kākākṣivat yojanāṃ āha jñānasya paravedyatā viṣayatā ca dūṣitā yataḥ evamabhyupagame ca bījamātram asti svalakṣaṇāni jñānāni bhinnānīti naiyāyikamate jñānaṃ tacca idamubhayam api apākīrṇam svadarśane'pi asti bījam māyāśaktirevaṃ kuryād iti tacca etat na yuktam bahirbodhasvarūpameva māyayā anyathākriyate viśvasya sā hi bodhasya śaktis tadāyattā tadabhāve kathaṃ syāt nirmāṇaṃ tu svātmany api kurutāṃ nāma natu nirmātṛrūpaṃ śuddhaṃ bodhaṃ bādhitum alam yathoktam tasya anāvṛtarūpatvāt ... iti atra nimittaṃ yatra sthitam idaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasmācca nirgatam iti āvaraṇaśatam api kutra bhāseta kutaśca udbhavet saṃvidi eva udbhavati ca tata eva iti abhāsane anudbhave ca kimāvaraṇam na māyāśaktir bodhaṃ bhindyāt bhedyatve bodhatvāt tathāpica bodhasya apratyastamayāt anyathā bodhasya api kaḥ prakāśaḥ iti yadi tathā iti natu etat saṃbhavatīti yāvat yat nareśvaraviveke nacā nupapannaṃ māyāśaktyāpi śakyate kartum iti sa eva tathaiva tatraiva tameva prati nāsti astīti ca śraddhīyate māyāta etadevam iti vacanamātreṇa eṣa ca asaṃbhavas turyapādasya āvṛttyā kākusahāyayā sūtrito mantavyaḥ prakṛtasya dārḍhyaṃ tunā āha kartṛkarmapratyayabhede'pi anubhavaḥ kartṛstha eva iti bhāvaḥ ātmā jñānadvayasamavāyikāraṇamātraṃ vaiśeṣikasya ivetyāha audāsīnyāt iti sa hi dvayoḥ kevalam ādhāratvena asti ghaṭa iva rūparasayoḥ natu dvayor melanāya samarthaḥ jñānāntaram api jñānadvayaviṣayameva rūparasayor iva guṇatvam yāvat iti yad iti ityarthaḥ

saivam ity api tadvyākaraṇamevāsyā mayā dṛṣṭam iti smṛteḥ anubhavo grāhakenaiva milatu tasminneva tu smaryamāṇe vedyīkṛte kiṃ vācyam ghaṭe mama anubhavo'bhūd ity apikathane ghaṭa eva vedyaḥ yathāha tatrabhavān ghaṭajñānam iti jñānaṃ ghaṭajñānavilakṣaṇam ghaṭa ity api yajjñānaṃ viṣayopanipāti tat iti taṃ hi matatyaktaṃ vivecayan iti smṛtiparāmarśo maulikaḥ tasya vṛttiḥ darśanasya pṛthaksṛṣṭatāyām api guṇatvena bhedasya aprarūḍhatvāt tasyā vibhāgam akartuṃ ṭīkā tasmin ghaṭe jñānam abhūt iti tasyaiva prādhānyena sṛṣṭasya bhedaprarohāt mūlapratītiśca vyākhyānapratītyā na bādhyate apitu upavṛṃhyate iti pūrvamuktameva sarvam sūtravṛttiṭīkāsu sarvaṃ hi etat vitatya nirṇītam spaṣṭam api etat na vastuto maulikasya bādhakam iti yāvat

smṛtir anujīvati avikalpite smaraṇāsaṃbhavāt tatastad smṛtyā tadagocarīkṛtaṃ spṛśyate khapuṣyam iva naca anubhavāṃśo vedyatvena adhyavasito smadarthe sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśrānter iti darśayati yā ca paśyāmy aham imaṃ ghaṭo'yam iti vā vasā sāpy avasātari manyate samavetaṃ darśanam caśabdaḥ smaraṇasya etadupajīvakatām āha vadhyavasāyaḥ paśyāmi ity evaṃ jāyate sā tāvat darśanam avasātari grāhakāṃśe pratyavamṛśantī tadanubhavasaṃskārāt manyate tathaiva sākṣātkurute svaśabdaparāmṛṣṭaṃ darśanaṃ na bhāti tatra api ayam iti tāvat pratyakṣatā parāmṛśyate sā ca na bhāvanīyaṃ rūpam apitu darśanameva tacca na bhāvadharmatvena adhyavasīyate idamarthena saṃbhedābhāvāt tasmāt na vedyo'nubhavo'dhyavasāye vedyatāvyāpakedantāviruddhā smadarthasaṃbhedopalabdheḥ na smṛtyā anubhavo vedyatvena bhāsyate tathānadhyavasāyāt asmadarthasaṃbhedādhyavasāyāt veti smṛtinirbhāsanāyāḥ kāraṇasya anupalabdhiḥ kāraṇāviruddhasya vā iti sūtrārthaḥ smṛtiḥ naca kvacid api adhyavasāyo anubhavam idantayā viṣayīkaroti tataḥ sā api katham itthaṃ kurvatī vā adhyavasāyarūpatāṃ jahyād iti sūtratātparyam avatārayati pratyakṣa ityādinā saṃkṣepavivaraṇena darśanaṃ prarāmṛśyate iti saṃbandhaḥ adhyavasāye na asmadaḥ na dṛśaḥ prayogaḥ tat kutra viśrāntaṃ kiṃ parāmṛśyate satyam na etayor asti prayogaḥ tena tu vinā api tadubhayārthaparāmarśo'sti ayam iti tad etat darśayati ghaṭarūpameva avamṛśyate netyāha pratyakṣatvāparāmarśe ca svatantravikalpāt asya na bhedaḥ iti na atra ayaṃśabdo ghaṭarūpatāparāmarśaviśrāntimātreṇa kṛtībhavati apitu tadīyayogyadeśasthatvaparāmarśamukhena tatpratyakṣatāparāmarśe viśrāmyati ghaṭadharma eva netyāha ahaṃkāragocaraḥ pramātṛmayaḥ hi iti yata evaṃ tato smacchabdenaiva ubhayatra darśanaparāmarśa iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ ayam iti yaḥ sūtre vasāya uktaḥ sa pratyakṣasya rūpaṇātmā adhyavasānasvabhāvaḥ natu ghaṭamātrasya iti evaṃ vṛttau vyākhyāto darśanameva tat pratyavamṛśyate iti vacanena ayam iti hi śabdo ghaṭātmānaṃ yadyapi sāmānādhikaraṇyena avalambate tathāpi iyati eva na viśrāmyati yathoktam idamityasya vicchinnavimarśasya kṛtārthatā iti svaviśrāntimeva ahaṃbhāvasya abhimukhīkaroti pratītāv api pratyakṣatā svaviśrāntaiva madīyo ghaṭa itivat sūtre idam āha yādṛk darśanasya vapus tadeva nirūpyaṃ svasaṃvedane nirbhāsanayogyam vikalpāṃśavicārastatra kva upayujyate bhavatu vā tathāpi vikalpanam api na idantodantam āviṣkarotīti sā dṛk mameti vikalpo na laukikasya haṭhavivecakaṃmanyasya api kasyacit bhavan prakṛtipratyayārthavibhāgakaraṇavat kalpanāmātram sa ghaṭa itivat dṛgantaram apekṣyeteti anavasthā dṛśeśca kartṛsthabhāvakatvam uktaṃ prakaṭatāphalabhāvanātmā dṛg ātmavartinī eva uktā ghaṭaṃ paśyāmi ghaṭo'yaṃ ghaṭe mama dṛg iti śabdavaicitryamātram tattvārthastu avicitra eva smaraṇe'pi tad iti aham anvabhūvam iti mayā anubhūtam iti sā mama dṛgāsīd iti śabdavaicitryamātram eva iti sūtradvayasya tātparyam

smaraṇānubhavayośca saṃvidrūpatvaṃ tattvam sāmarthyād idamāyātam grāhyagrāhakau śuddhasaṃvinmayāveva bhāsete tato vakṣyamāṇasya sūtrasya vācyaḥ apitu sa eva artha ekīkṛtya upasaṃharaṇīya iti avatārayati idaṃ vastu upasaṃharann āha upasaṃhāropalakṣitam āha tanmayā dṛśyate dṛṣṭo'yaṃ sa iti āmṛśaty api grāhyagrāhakatābhinnāv arthau pramātari yad etat pūrvam uktam tasmāt hetoḥ yat viśuddhasaṃvidrūpe pramātari grāhyagrāhakarūpatayā parasparāpekṣayā bhinnau vedyāv arthau bhāsete iti kīdṛśe mayā dṛśyate mayā dṛṣṭe iti ca anubhavasmaraṇāmarśanopalakṣite ayam iti sa iti ca darśanabhāgānādaraṇena anubhūyamānasmaryamāṇārthabhāgapradhānena āmarśena upalakṣite apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ bhinnāv api ekatra ābhāsete iti vṛttyanusāreṇa vā yojanā ye tu sthūladṛṣṭayaḥ prakaraṇārthaṃ vivektum aśaktāḥ tān prati codyapūrvakam apūrvārthābhidhānam idam ityanayā cchāyayā avatārayati athaveti parihariṣyann āha iti saṃgatiḥ samastasya pariharaṇaprakārasya svakaṇṭhena anabhidhānāt na vartamānanirdeśaḥ apitu bhaviṣyatprayogaḥ abhiprāyāntarvartino bhaviṣyattaiva ucitā yataḥ parihartum abhiprāyeṇa upalakṣaṇam āha naiva hyanubhava ... ityādiślokaireva mātṛviśrāntasya darśanāder avabhāsa iti samarthite'pi prakṛtaṃ prameyaṃ tenaikyaṃ bhinnakālānāṃ saṃvidāṃ ... iti na samarthitameva avasāturahaṃ gauraḥ kṣudhitaḥ sukhīti prāṇabuddhirūpasya asaṃvidrūpatvād atyantabhedācceti parihāraḥ āmarśanena upalakṣitaḥ saṃvitsvabhāvo yataḥ pramātā upapadyate kalpitagrāhaka tu bhavann api grāhyavat tatraiva nirbhāsate tat iti tasmāt hetoḥ saṃvidekatā na na samarthiteti abhiprāyaḥ pūrvamanubhavopādānaṃ tatpūrvakatvāt smṛteḥ tasyā eva prakṛtatvam ityāśayena tu vṛttau saiva prathamam uktā vivṛtāvapi tadanusāreṇa iha abhisaṃdhāne draṣṭṛbhāgabahumāne ca dṛk prādhānyena parāmṛśyate ādaraṇameva puraḥsarapūrvādiśabdair darśitam anādaraṇaṃ tu parityāgādiśabdaiḥ anabhisaṃdhau dṛśyabhāgabahumāne ca dṛgbhāgo na ādriyate apitu arthabhāga eva iti caturdhā anubhave ṣoḍaśadhā ca smṛtau ubhayaspṛśi ca pratyabhijñāne catuḥṣaṣṭidhā pūrvāparabhāgabhedaprādhānyena ca dviguṇībhūte vartamāne heyopādeyādibhedena punar api bhinne svatantravikalpe ca utprekṣādilakṣaṇe sarvasminnevam atra saṃvedane grāhako grāhyaśca parasparāpekṣayā bhinnaprathau parasparāpekṣyā ca grāhyagrāhakatāṃ gatau yugalasṛṣṭiyogena bhinnau prakāśete parāmarśanasvatantrakartṛsvabhāve saṃvidrūpe viśuddhapramātari vacanena sūtre bhāvapratyayaprakṛte dvandvasya itaretarayogo darśitaḥ sahavivakṣā ca atraiva yuktā dvayor api grāhyatvāt grāhakatvācca yadāha tayor vicchinnā anyonyapṛthagbhūtā prathā āha idantāparāmarśāt satyāmeva vedyatāyām ahamiti parāmarśasya kṛtakasya kalpitasya āspadatāṃ haṭhādeva yato grāhako nīto haṃ gauro'yam iti yataśca grāhyo ghaṭādiḥ prakāśamātraparamārtho'pi idantāyāḥ prakāśabhinnatvaparāmarśasya gocaratāṃ balādeva prāpitaḥ tata etau vicchinnaprathau vicchinnaprathau tarhi katham ekapramātari protau kiṃ maṇidvayasya iva tantau pramātari protatvam anayoḥ netyāha kathaṃ tarhi tanmayau viśuddhapramātṛparamārthād adhikam anayor na kiṃcit vapuḥ iti cet āha grāhakasya tāvat iti ayatnopapannam etad iti tāvatpadam yadyapyarthasthitiḥ prāṇapuryaṣṭakaniyantrite jīve niruddhā tatrāpi paramātmani sā sthitā tadātmanaiva tasya syāt kathaṃ prāṇena yantraṇā iti nyāyo'tra anusaraṇīya iti tāvacchabdābhiprāyaḥ

grāhyam idam iti vimṛśyamānaṃ cakāsti tathāpi idamityasya vicchinnavimarśasya kṛtārthatā yā svasvarūpe viśrāntir vimarśaḥ so'ham ity ayam iti prakāśasyātmaviśrāntir ahaṃbhāvo hi kīrtitaḥ iti ca nayena ahantāviśrāntataiva pāryantikī iti sārapadasya abhiprāyaḥ ṭīkāyām vartamānāvabhāsānāṃ ... ityādinā prakaraṇena idameva vitaniṣyate ityarthaḥ prakāśamānatā sā tu na grāhyasya svarūpaprathāyāṃ cakāsti ghaṭasyaiva cakāsa yataḥ satyam ghaṭasya tu iyameva cakāsā yā prakāśamānatāyāḥ prathā anyathā ghoṭo prakāśita eva ityāśayena cecchabdaḥ pāramārthika iti yāvat idam iti cakāsat bhagavataḥ śaktyā māyayā vicchedita iti astu nāma gāhakastu aham iti nirbhāsamānaḥ kathaṃ prakāśāt chedita iti parasya bhramaṃ bhinatti pāramārthikaprakāśalakṣaṇa cinmātraparamārthā hi bhāvāḥ anyathā teṣāṃ prakāśanāsaṃbhavāt tadapekṣayā ca māyāśaktir yadi bhāvān vicchindyāt tad aprakāśarūpāṃs tān nirbhāsayatīti uktaṃ syāt na ca etat yuktam prakāśante ca na prakāśante ceti tataḥ pāramārthikaprakāśāt tāvad abhinnā eva sarvadā te upagamyam atidurghaṭakāriṇī kiṃ kiṃ na kuryāt bodhānām api kartṛtvajuṣāṃ kārmamalakṣatau bhinnavedyajuṣāṃ māyāmalaṃ vidyeśvarāśca te iti vakṣyate tataśca bodharūpaṃ paramārthaprakāśam apekṣya bhāvānāṃ bhedena prathā na yuktā etad āśaṅkya gamayati bodhasya hi viśvātmano'pi māyābhidhānabhagavacchaktikṛtāyāṃ viśvātmatvākhyātirūpatāyāṃ māyīyāparaparyāyāyāṃ khaṇḍanāyāṃ satyām api vedyīkaraṇam arthānāṃ malo māyākhya ucyate mūlam ... iti dṛśā bahirmukhatāyām antarmukhasaṃkocāntarābhāvāt prakāśarūpatāyāḥ sarvān vedyān prati sā prakāśarūpatā iti sā bhedena prathā sarvajñatvarūpā bhavet naca sarve sarvajñāḥ asarvajñatāyāmpica vicchedena prathanam asti apūrvatathāvidhaprathālakṣaṇa nirmāṇaviṣayatayā kāryaśabdavācyasya bhūtasṛṣṭer grāhakarūpāyā idānīṃ mīmāṃsāvasaraḥ tadupayoginī eva bhāvasṛṣṭir ityāśayena āgamoktacaturvidhasṛṣṭimadhyāt sṛṣṭidvayameva ṭīkākṛtā darśitam asarvajñatāyāṃ yat bhedena prathanam tad ittham upapadyate yadi bodharūpo'ham iti prakāśabhāge'pi kaścit saṃkoco bhavet saṃkucito hi aham iti prakāśabhāgo nālikāsuṣirasaṃkucitacākṣuṣaprakāśavat niyataprakāśa iti yuktam taduktam anyastvahaṃbhāvo vedyeṣvapy āṇavo malaḥ iti dehādau grāhyarāśāveva patita iti punar api grāhyagrāhakatābhinnau iti sūtre grāhakapadam asamarthitamevety āśaṅkya āha tadānīm iti śarīram idaṃ kṛśam ityādyavasare bhavatu udbhūtavedyatākaṃ dehādi ahaṃ kṛśo ghaṭaṃ vedmītyādi pratye tu ahamitisaṃvidabhiṣekarasa eva utsiktāvabhāsaḥ na grāhyatāṃśaḥ

kṛśāder api avaśyabhāvinyā idantāyāṃ yadi tāvad aham ity anena rūpeṇa tad īśvararūpataiveti kiṃ grāhakapadopādānena tarhi ghaṭādivat grāhyarūpataiveti punar api kiṃ tena tatra prathamāṃ śaṅkāṃ prādhānyena vedyarāśeranyaiva prasaṅgataśca atraiva dvitīyāpi parihṛtā bhavatīti varṇayiṣyate vastujātam īśvarasya avabhāsate āha trīṇi api amūni ekaikaṃ parasparasmād tata eva viśvameva avabhāsanaprasādoditena vapuṣā na virodhaḥ kaścit atra tu iti māyāpade pramātrantarebhyaḥ prameyebhyaśca yat bhinnaṃ prāṇadhīśūnyarūpam ahantāveśena saṃvitsvātantryābhiṣekeṇa pratyagātmeti parasparāsaṃkīrṇasvasaṃvedanasaṃjñam tat grāhakībhūtaṃ svavyatiriktasya grāhyasya ghaṭāder iti saṃbandhaḥ sā saṃvit viśvarūpatvamasahiṣṇur iti aṇur ucyate pārimityāt bhagavata idaṃ prathamikā vidyate grahyagrāhakayugalakanirmāṇakāriṇyāṃ māyāśaktāv iti nityatvam asya uktam tat prāṇādisaṃvidi cet vilīnīkṛtam tat punar api na tato bhāvānāṃ bhedaḥ satyaṃ natu vilīnīkṛtaṃ tat ātmīyatvena yo bhedo vedyatvaṃ tatra yo gāḍhagrāstasya atiraskārāt tad anena paśulakṣaṇaṃ svīkṛtam yaduktaṃ śrīkiraṇāyāṃ paśur nityo hy amūrto jño niṣkriyo nirguṇo prabhuḥ vyāpī māyodarāntaḥstho bhogāpāyavicintakaḥ iti paśuḥ anāditvāt nityaḥ ahantāveśanād amūrto vyāpī ca svabhāvato vedyatvāt jñānakriyāśūnyaḥ māyābhūmipatitaḥ tata eva asvatantraḥ vedakatvāt sattvādivedyaguṇagaṇottīrṇaḥ saṃvidrūpatve'pi apūrṇatvāt bhogalālasākrānto yato navarataṃ pūrṇatvaṃ kāmyati prakṛte yojayati evamuktena krameṇa śarīrādau vedyatā tādṛśī yā na īśvaravedye'rthe nāpi saṃsārijanavedye ghaṭādau vedakatā ca api īśvaravedakatāvilakṣaṇā hi iti yasmādevaṃ tasmād idam aham iti bhāgadvayasya api īśvaraniṣṭhāt rūpāt vilakṣaṇatvaṃ māyāpramātari tasmāt īśvarasya iveti yukta ivaśabdārthaḥ vilīnatvābhāvaṃ sphuṭayati yathā yathā hi bhāvanopadeśabalāt vedyatā prāṇāder apasāryate vedakataiva nirbhāsyate tathā tathā saṃvitsvātantryadharmodayāt khecaratvādisiddhyudayaḥ yāvad eṣā vārtā yat ghaṭādi sabrahmacāri nirbhāsate kimaṅga buddhiprāṇādāv iti evakāraḥ tena bhagavata eva māyāyogāt mālinyaṃ syāt netyāha evaṃvidhaparamādbhūtabhāsane yat vaibhavam apratighātalakṣaṇam antaḥ- sthitabhāvarāśipravikāsanalakṣaṇavijṛmbhāsaṃbhārarūpaṃ na tat mālinyam ākṣipati aindrajālikasya iva mālinyaṃ hi saṃvido bhīṣṭapratighātalakṣaṇam tadviruddhaśca apratihatasvecchāyoga iti svabhāvaviruddhopalabdhiḥ śarīrādi vedyameva vedakīkriyate tadā tasya vedyatāyāṃ kiṃ vedakam āha tadeva iti yat grāhakīkṛtaṃ ghaṭādau grāhye yoginaḥ iti sākṣātkārajñānena jighṛkṣataḥ iti āśayaḥ cittattvaṃ tasya prāṇabuddhyāder vedakaṃ bhavati ity api sākṣātkāre tadvedyarūpābhāvaniṣedhātmakaṃ śūnyāntarameva tadapekṣayā vikasitam iva pramātrībhavati tatrāpi vikasitataram ityādikrameṇa mahāśūnyam āgameṣu śūnyātiśūnyaśabdavācyaṃ pāryantikaṃ pramātṛrūpam ullasati abhāvasya abhāva iti bhāvarūpataiva iyam iti vaktavyam abhāvasya tuccharūpasya abhāvāntaram api tuccharūpameveti hi vakṣyate vedyāpekṣayā ca tucchatvaṃ saṃvidrūpaṃ bhittipātācca vedakatvam śūnyātiśūnyaṃ nāma vedyarāśivinirmukta śuddhasvabhāvasaṃvidrūpaṃ citsvasaṃvedanasaṃviditam iti na anavasthā yaduktaṃ tathāhi vedyate yadyat tanmadhye haṃ na kaścana apitvetad vimukto'smi naca dṛśyo'smi tādṛśaḥ iti bhāvaniṣedho haṃbhāvabhūtas tattvataḥ sthitaḥ tasya puryaṣṭakādy etad vedyaṃ yogidṛśi sphuṭam tatra bhāvaniṣedho yaḥ so'pi nātyantatucchakaḥ ahaṃsaṃvidupārohāt tatastan may eva saḥ iti ākāśasamāpattyabhyāse gṛhaprāṅgaṇāraṇyādipradeśa- vikāsatāratamyābhyāsena brahmāṇḍādibahirbhūtaparamākāśasamāpattir iti āgamaḥ bahirakalpitā vṛttir mahāvidehā ityatra api eṣaiva parākāśaśarīratā pāryantikī prāpyatvena uktā

vedyatāyāṃ śarīrasya tasya api dhīḥ tasyāḥ śūnyo vedakaḥ iti prasiddho'yamarthaḥ iti anukrameṇa tu samastasya śūnyameva vedakam saṃprajñātasamādhisamārūḍhasya śakyaṃ dehaprāṇāder vedyatāṃ kartum ayogī tu śarīrādyuttīrṇaṃ śūnyaṃ śabdato'pi na śrutavān tat kathaṃ tadapekṣayā asya vedyatā ityāśaṃkāyām āha anyena tu iti na tena asya dehāder haṃbhāvāspṛṣṭasya vyatiriktaghaṭādivedyavargasagotratayā sākṣātkāraḥ apitu aham idam ity eva sākṣātkāraḥ kevalam vedyatā tu anena vikalpyate paraṃ na sākṣātkriyate sattādravyatvaśuklādyaśeṣopādhivinirmuktatā iva dravyasya kalpanāyāṃ tadrūpasaṃpattiḥ pratīkṣyā yena kevalavedyatāsiddhaye vedakāntarānveṣaṇaṃ bhavet martyaloke jīvanneva hi svargitāṃ kalpayann ātmano na tatsaṃpattim apekṣate vikalpena tadrūpasaṃpattir apekṣyā asākṣsatkārātmakatvāt bhāvasvabhāvānuvartitā hi saṃvedanasya sākṣātkārarūpatayā vyāptā anyathā na kaścit sākṣātkāro tadviruddhaṃ ca sākṣātkārarūpatvam iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiḥ śuddhā saṃvideva pramātṛtvena ucyatām śūnyam antarāle kim iti kalpyate athāpi astyevaṃ yoginaḥ pratipattiḥ yadyadvikalpyate kiṃcin na tattadrūpam iti so'yam ātmā neti neti ca nītyā sarvavedyavimuktaṃ yat tad aham iti yathā saṃsāriṇaḥ tṛṣito'haṃ sukhy aham iti tat kaḥ kalpanārthaḥ iti ucyate tathāpi śarīrāder yugapat yoginā vedane śūnyāntareṇa kim antarālikena atra āha yadi śūnyaṃ na vedakaṃ syāt tat mahāprakāśāt na kiṃcit vyatiriktaṃ prakāśeta aprakāśanaprasaṃgād iti vyatirekajīvitā vedyataiva kathaṃ nirvahet anugrahārthaṃ parameśvaraḥ svayameva ātmānaṃ śiṣyebhya upadiśati ahameva bhavatām ātmā iti tadā bhagavati vedake kim anyat vedyaṃ syāt ucyate tat iti svarūpam īśvaratayā prakāśatayā vā iti vāgrahaṇena idamāha na khalu avibhāgaṃ śuddhasaṃvidrūpaṃ vedyībhāvam abhyeti kintu atadrūpavyāvṛttyā jānann iti apūrvābhāsatayā sṛjanīyaṃ nirmitavānekadharmamukhena rūpam tadeva parāmṛśan bhagavān anuśāsti śiṣyān eṣa īśvaro madrūpo bhavatām ātmā iti na punaḥ sākṣāt vedakarūpam upadeṣṭṛtayā sthitaṃ svaprakāśaṃ yat tadeva śiṣyān prati tena ātmatayā anuśāsanīyam upadeśyaṃ yuktaṃ yathā śarīrādi vedyam ātmatayā upadeṣṭuṃ yuktam iti vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ siddhāpādāḥ atītaḥ panthānaṃ tava sa mahimā vāṅmanasayo- ratadvyāvṛttyāyaṃ cakitam abhidhatte śrutirapi iti tadaivam iti anyeṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ ātmābhāso nirmitaḥ san na śarīrādivat sarvapramātṛsādhāraṇo vedyaḥ apitu saṃvedane parāmarśe ca upadeśakopadeśyayoḥ paraṃ parisphurati natu bahir ityarthaḥ evamuktena nayena vedakarūpaṃ svaprakāśam iti ātmīyaṃ bhagavatā rūpaṃ śiṣyāṇām ātmatvena na upadiṣṭaṃ tāvat apitu nirmitaḥ kaścidābhāsaḥ iti āha tadapi iti yadā ābhāsātmakaṃ svarūpam uktam tat tadeva iti parameśvarasvarūpameva na adhikam iti vakṣyate svātantryāmuktaṃ ātmānaṃ ... ityatra tad iti svarūpeṇa militasya pūrvam abhidhānam ityāśayena tadapi iti napuṃsakatā yuktā sūtrārthatattvaṃ śiṣyabuddhisamādhaye nigamayati ghaṭādeḥ śarīrādeḥ svarūpasya ca vedyatā sākṣātkāryavikalpanīyādirūpeṇa vicitrā uktā māyāpramātuḥ yoginaḥ īśvarasya bhagavatparamaśivasya ca vicitrā grāhakatā uktā grāhyagrāhakayugalakam anantāvāntarabhedabheditaṃ paramaprakāśarūpe bhagavati bhāti tadrūpeṇa prakāśamānatvāt mahādarpaṇa iva parigṛhītapratibimbaṃ darpaṇavaiśvarūpyam iti svabhāvahetuḥ yadi atanmaye syāt tad aniyataṃ bhavet ghaṭo'pi paṭatayā prakāśeteti vyāpakaniyamaviruddhāniyamaprasaṅgāt tadrūpeṇa prakāśamānatvaṃ vipakṣād atanmayatvāt vyāvṛttaṃ tanmayatvena vyāpyate iti vyāpyasiddhiḥ śrīmahāmāheśvaraśrīmadācāryābhinavagupta-viracitāyā-mīśvarapratyabhijñāvivṛtivimarśinyāṃ smṛtiśakti-vimarśaścaturthaḥ

ānanda-
> vikasvarecchayā pūrṇam īśvaram unmiṣadamṛtaughasundaraṃ smṛtiśaktiṃ tatprasaṅgena ca vimṛśya vartamānābhāsānāṃ ... ityādyayā sakramaṃ pratibhāsate ityantayā ślokaikaviṃśatyā vitatya evaṃbhūtā jñānaśaktir iti ślokena pratijānīte dvayena prakāśa eva arthānāṃ svarūpam ityāha prakāśabāhyānāmarthānāṃ vijñānavādoktadūṣaṇena dṛḍhīkṛtaṃ sadbhāvaṃ dvayena āśaṅkya ekena tadanupagame tāvat na kiñcid uparudhyate iti kathayati arthatattvam upadarśayan bāhye arthe pratikṣipati ekena dvayena anumānam arthānāṃ cidātmani iti ekena āha pramātṛrūpasya prakāśasya vimarśa eva sāram iti catuṣkena āha jñānaparāmarśa eva jñeyaṃ śuddham anujjhitapramātṛbhāvaṃ prathayatīti trayeṇa prakāśaikarūpatāyām api ekena jñātari iva viśuddhe jñāne'pi avikalpakasavikalpakatājuṣi jīvitaṃ vimarśa eva iti dvayena jñātṛjñānayor bhinnatvaṃ dūṣitaṃ yat pūrvapakṣe tad ekena samarthayate iti tātparyam avabhāsanam antaḥsthitavatāmeva ghaṭate bahirātmanā na arthaḥ sarvapramātṛsādhāraṇo bhedena bhāti yatra api tathā tatra api anubhavādanatirekī asau kā tu kathā tadupajīvini smaraṇādāv iti vṛttāv apiśabdo yāvacchabdaśca sūtraśeṣatvena paṭhitaḥ vartamānatvena sphuṭatayā idam ity evamākāram avabhāsanaṃ yeṣāṃ te śūnyādimāyāpramātṛpṛthagbhāvena bhinnāḥ tato māyāpramātur vicchinnāḥ teṣāṃ tathāvidham api yad avacchinnatayā bhāsanaṃ tat antaḥsthitavatāmeva śuddhacitātmaka paramārthapramātṛtattva ghaṭate yujyate pramāṇena kalpitapramātrapekṣayā vicchedena yat prakāśanaṃ sā bhagavato jñānaśaktir iti yāvat prakārāntaratvaṃ sphuṭayati śiṣṭaṃ vṛttivivṛtyoḥ spaṣṭam

yadupajīvanena uktaṃ ṭīkākṛtā tat sūtram avatārayati prāgivārtho prakāśaḥ syāt prakāśātmatayā vinā na ca prakāśo bhinnaḥ syād ātmārthasya prakāśatā prakāśāt na bhinno'rthaḥ prakāśamāno yuktaḥ prakāśamānāt ca arthāt na bhinnaḥ prakāśo yukta iti ubhayatomukham arthaprakāśayor bhedam apasārayan prathamam ardhaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa vyācaṣṭe yathā jñānānudaye nīlaṃ sarvān prati nīlaṃ na kaṃcit vā prati apitu svātmani svātmani apivā tat na kiṃcit tadvadeva jñāne'pi udite syāt natu prakāśeta iti syāt iti prakāśatādātmyamasya pūrvavadeva iti anubhavarūpataiva ityādinā dvitīyam pūrvavad aprakāśatā syāt tasmāt prakāśamānatā nāma arthasya na bhinnā tata evamāyātaṃ prakāśa eva arthasya ātmā svarūpabhūto yaḥ prakāśaḥ so'rthasya prakāśamānatā natu tasmādarthāt bhinnaḥ san prakāśaḥ so'rthasya prakāśamānatā yuktet i prasaṅgāt ityantena prathamārdhāvatāraṇaṃ arthācca ityādinā tṛtīyapādārthasaṃkṣepābhidhānam arthaśarīraviśrānta eva prakāśo'stu arthavat bhinnasvabhāva ity āśaṃkāyām āha arthaśarīratve ca arthavad asya bhedaḥ prāpnoti naca sa yukto nusandhānābhāvaprasaṅgāt vyācaṣṭe artha eva cet prakāśamānatātmā tarhi tato hetoḥ prakāśasya svātmani bhedaḥ prāpnoti yadivā tamavalambya vartamāno yaḥ prakāśas tasya saṃbandhi yat svarūpaṃ tasya bhedaḥ prāpnoti naca asau yuktaḥ tasmād arthasya prakāśamānatā nāma ātmā paramārtharūpaṃ natu bhinnaḥ kaścid arthaḥ prakāśamānatā anubhavarūpatā ātmā natu prakāśamānatāyā arthātmatā iti vṛttirevaṃ netavyā arthasya yā prakāśamānatā sā prakāśo nubhavaḥ natu asau prakāśamānatātmā prakāśo rthasya svarūpabhūto rthaśarīramagnaḥ tathāhi sati arthabhedāt bhinnaḥ syāt naca tathā yuktaḥ ghaṭataiva svarūpaṃ tat jñānodaye pūrvam api tat kā anyā asya prakāśamānatā ityāśaṃkya āha na kaṃcana iti etaddhi vastutattvaṃ parasya paraniṣṭhāyogāt pūrvaṃ tu saṃbhāvanayā kṛtvā cintāmapekṣya uktaṃ sarvān prati samam upayogāt iti upayogo'pi hi prakāśamānatāyattaḥ natu ghaṭatāmātrādhīnaḥ upādānāt ghaṭakṣaṇāt prakāśamānaghaṭarūpo viśiṣṭaḥ kṣaṇo jātaḥ tadastyeva prāgavasthāto vijñānodayakāle viśeṣaḥ natu sthirapadārthavādinām iva asmākaṃ sa eva asau ghaṭa ity āśaṃkāyāṃ brūte pramātuḥ iti tato hi indriyādisāmagrīto ghaṭe viśeṣo jātaḥ prakāśamānatā ālokādapica āloke'pica ghaṭādeva ādyarūpavilakṣaṇatā ghaṭālokādeśca pramātṛsantāne jñānodayaḥ tatra ca yathā sa jñānodayo na ghaṭaṃ prati naca ghaṭa ālokaṃ prati tulye'pi kāraṇatve ekasāmagryadhīnatāyāṃ vā vyavahāryatāmeti svarūpasya svaniṣṭhatvāt tathā so'pi ghaṭagato viśeṣaḥ prakāśamānatākhyo na pramātāraṃ prati vyavahāryaḥ syāt tat na anyaniṣṭhaṃ nīlasya iva pītaniṣṭham tathāca prakāśamānatā ghaṭasyeti na pramātṛniṣṭhā anyaniṣṭatve svarūpatā na upapadyate viruddhadharmādhyāsaprasaṅgāt anyaniṣṭhatā hi anyatādātmyaṃ svarūpatā na anyatādātmyam iti svabhāvaviruddhopalabdhiḥ

arthalabdham api svakaṇṭhena kathayati svarūpaniṣṭhataiva vikalpānām apratihataprasaratvād evaṃ vyavahriyate tarhi niyamānupapattiḥ yatra svātantryamicchāyā ... iti nyāyāt darśayati indriyāditathābhūtaghaṭatāviśeṣaprakāśamānatā udaye nidānatāṃ pratipadyate tameva pramātāraṃ prati tathā vyavahriyate iti siddho niyamaḥ etat dūṣayati upayogāya iti na ghaṭatā kulālameva prati asyeti bhāvaḥ kāryasya saṃbandho dṛṣṭo bījasya aṅkuraḥ kulālasya ghaṭa iti tadvadeva caitrasya ghaṭaḥ prakāśamāna iti bhaviṣyati etāvat tu iha sādhyam tacca siddham tat ko'nya upayogo nāmetyāśayena śaṅkate etat na sahate na yuktam iti etāvatā tatkṛtā prakāśamānatā ghaṭasyeti uktam bījakṛtā aṅkuratā kulālakṛtā ca ghaṭatā natu sā aṅkuratā ghaṭatā ca svārthakriyākālavyavahriyamāṇāṃ kāraṇakalāṃ bhittitvena upādāya vyavahriyate kāraṇanirbhāsanāpekṣayaiva aṅkurādisvarūpavyavahārāt prakāśamānatā tu mameti caitrasyeti ca bhittibhūtaṃ pramātāram avalambya niyamena vyavahriyate tallagnatvena niyataṃ vyavaharaṇaṃ tat tādātmyam ānayati ghaṭapratibimbasya iva darpaṇalagnatvena tādātmyaṃ hi tadrūpatvaṃ svaniṣṭhatvaṃ ca atadrūpatvam iti svānyarūpadvayaṃ bhāvasya kathaṃ syāt ghaṭaprakāśamānatāyāḥ pramātṛtādātmyam ānayati niyamena tallagnatayā prathamānatvāt ghaṭatādātmyaṃ ca asyāḥ svabhāva iti tamatikramya kathaṃ prathanaṃ syāt prathamānaiva tathā bhavati iti tatrāpi ayameva vidhiriti arthakriyayā api na bāhyatā siddhyati dharmottaradṛśeti vaktuṃ paryavasitārthaḥ iti arthapadam tadāha bhaṭṭaḥ prakāśenāvinābhūtaiḥ sattāyāṃ niyatātmabhiḥ dharmair bhāvaḥ pṛthagbhāvo na bāhyasiddhimṛcchati iti sā prakāśamānatā bhittibhāvena anavalambamānā pramātāraṃ prathamānā dṛṣṭā yena tatra satyabhāvam avasthāpya tatra anaikāntatāṃ brūyāma nāmetyāśayena āha bāhyo'rthaḥ paramāṇusaṃcayamātrasvabhāva iva sa prathayā vyavahriyamāṇo nyalagnatvena bhrāntyā nirbhāsatāṃ sthūlarūpa iva tat ko virodha iti paramatam āśaṃkya āha bhrāntir nāma prakāśamānatā vastvanumānānācaraṇeti natu anyat sā ca pramātṛbhittilagnatvena tacca na kiṃcid iti saṃvedanabhāgo'pi na upapadyate bhrāntau ca so bhrāntatayā avaśyasamarthanīyo rthāṃśe saṃvedanasya api asattve bhrāntir iti pāṣāṇatā syāt śuklaśaṃkho prathamāna eva iti nañam ācāryaḥ paṭhati na kāṃcit prathāṃ bhajate tat sitaśaṃkhaḥ pītatvena prathate iti niḥsāroktiḥ yaditu prakāśyasya prakāśātmabhāvaḥ ityatra pramāṇasiddha iti adhyāhriyate tadā nañ prapaṭhyate iha pareṇa pramāṇasiddhabheda iti yaduktam tatra pramāṇaṃ prakāśa eva tataśca yadi bhedaḥ siddhaḥ bhrāntyā tu anyalagnatāvyavahārastadā idam uktaṃ bhavati prakāśāt bhinnaḥ siddhaḥ tato bhinnatvena prakāśamānasaṃvedanato bhramavaśāt saṃvedanatādātmyena tallagnatayā mameti prakāśate iti naca etat yuktam ekasyāmeva pravṛttau tadatadrūpanirbhāsanayor ayogāt nahi bhavati śulkaśaṃkha eva bhāsamānaḥ pīto bhāsate iti

tathāca viniścayo etaddhi sahopalambhaniyamād abhedo iti vijñānākāramātraṃ nīlādi nirūpitam ity api tasya tādātmyāt tathā prathanaṃ natu saṃvedanād anyasya vyatiriktasya kasyacid upapadyate iti prathamam arthaṃ saṃkarasiddhaye vyākhyāya nirnibandhane paraniṣṭhatve viśeṣābhāvāt sarvasya paraniṣṭhatāpattau niyataparaniṣṭhatākṛtasya asaṃkarasya punar api evaṃbhūtamartham aparaṃ vyākaroti sākāratākṛta eva niyamaḥ yathāha tatra anubhavamātreṇa jñānasya sadṛśātmanaḥ bhāvyaṃ tenātmanā yena pratikarma vibhajyate iti nīlākāro pṛthagbhūto bodhād iti bhāvaḥ tatra tatra karmaṇi yā viśiṣṭatvena bodhasya pratikarma vyavasthā niyataparaniṣṭhatārūpā tāṃ sādhayitum āha paraḥ pramātuḥ iti ya eva yogye deśe sthitaḥ san vijñānasya janakas tasyaiva tat vijñānaṃ prakāśaḥ sa eva vijñānasya viṣayaḥ yadāha saṃvedanasya viṣayasya ca sahabhāvenaiva upalambhaḥ tat kathaṃ kāraṇabhūtasya nīlasya vijñānāt pūrvakālabhāvino viṣayatā ucyamānā anubhavabādhitā satī aṅgīkaraṇīyeti cet tarhi samānakāla eva viṣayo'stu pratyāsattiśca niyamakāriṇī ekasāmagryadhīnatātmā arthajñānakṣaṇalakṣaṇāt paryāyeṇa anyonyam upādānasahakāribhāvena vartamānād parasparonmukhau raṇarasikorabhrayugalakavat melanayogyau sopādānakāraṇaparamparāpratilabdha viṣayasaṃbodhau jātau doṣam āha janakatvaikasāmagryadhīnatālakṣaṇāt kāraṇād api yā tasyāstāvad aviśeṣo nīlapītayoḥ anyathā ubhayaviṣayaṃ kathaṃ tatsaṃvedanaṃ syāt nirākāratve ca saṃvedanaṃ nīle yat paṭu mandatvena anubhavo yasyety evam abhimatasya mandena vā anubhavena abhimatasya pītasyāpi saṃbandhitayā paṭīyastvenaiva abhimataṃ syāt nīlasyāpivā saṃbandhitayā mandatvena yadivā dvaye'pi nirākāratāpakṣe saṃvedanasya ko'pi viśeṣaḥ sa eva paṭumandatādinā saṃkaraḥ uktaḥ saṃkaram āha samakālameva yo nīle pīte ca anubhavaḥ tena dattaḥ saṃskāro yadā nīlamātradarśanena prabodhyate tadā nirviśeṣaḥ prabuddho nīlasyaiva na pītasyeti pītaprakāśātmā api bheved iti pīte'pi smṛtiḥ sā syāt śikharasthajñānaparidṛṣṭabhāvavaiśvarūpyasya punar samastapūrvānubhūtaviṣayā smṛtir iti loke asti anubhavaḥ niyamo bhaviṣyatīti parasya saṃbhāvanāṃ pūrvānubhavasya iti smṛtau punarunmiṣataḥ iti bhāvaḥ anubhavaḥ prabodhake nīladarśane niyate'pi prabodhyaṃ yat prācyamanubhavarūpaṃ saṃskāramukhena tat iti samānaprasaṅga iti śaṃkāṃ nikṛntati prabodhakabalāt tamākāram uddhurīkṛtya prabudhyate dvitīyaṃ tu ākāram avacchāditameva saṃskārarūpatayā udāsīnam iva apahastitam iva karotīti saṃkaradoṣaḥ uktaḥ tasya yat nirākaraṇaṃ svapakṣe tat pūrvoktasamastasaṃkaradoṣapraśamanopalakṣaṇaparaṃ mantavyam pratikarma vyavasthā nīlapītākārayoḥ paṭumandatayā parasparamasaṃkīrṇatā sākārakṣaṇikajñānasantānanaye vakṣyamāṇanītyā vāsanāsamarthanānirvahaṇād anupapannaṃ sarvānu-bhavāntarmukhaikasvatantrasaṃviddarśane tu upapannam iti nirūpayituṃ tatsadṛśānubhavasaṃvitprabodhitaḥ ityatra saṃvitpadam upāttam sūtrasya svapakṣe na ayaṃ doṣa iti abhiprāyo ntarlīnayā sūcitaḥ vakṣyati sautraṃ tacchabdam iti upakramya sarvameva iti parapakṣe duṣpariharamado doṣajātaṃ svadṛśi tu mūlata eva na avatared iti tasmād etat vyācaṣṭe prakāśasyaiva iti prakāśarūpataiva tasya jīvitam sā ca ghaṭe'pi paṭe'pi śakaṭe'pīti svatantrā pramātṛrūpā svaśaktyā svātmani darpaṇe iva ghaṭādīn ābhāsayati iti darpaṇasya lagnatvena yathā pratibimbāni bhānti natu darpaṇābhedam anādṛtya svātmapariniṣṭhitāni tathā amī ghaṭādayas tasyaiva prakāśasya lagnā tadanujīvitā nirbhāsante na svaniṣṭhitā iti yat mukhyaṃ prameyarūpam iha vitatya anyatra uktam evamātmanyasatkalpāḥ ... ityādinā tad api asmin sūtre pratipāditaṃ bhavati yena prāgupakrāntam antaḥkṛtānantaviśvarūpatvaṃ bhagavati nirvyūḍhaṃ bhavati iti

bāhyaṃ ced anumāpayet nahy abhinnasya bodhasya vicitrābhāsahetutā bodhābhinnasvabhāvatvaṃ satyaṃ nīlāder ābhāsavargasya samarthitam sattvābhāsavargo'pi yadi bodhasya svabhāvas tatsadaiva bodhas tathā cakāsyāt naca evam tasmāt kramikatvena ye vicitrā ābhāsāḥ tannirbhāse niyamanidānaṃ vaktavyam naca bodhasya tatra hetutvam avicitrāt vicitrakramikābhāsollāsāsaṃbhavāt hetubhedādhino hi kāryabhedaḥ tasmāt ekasyaiva bodhasya kramikānābhāsān pratibimbakalpena arpayituṃ caturastacchāyādhārī bāhyo'rthavargaḥ kalpanīyo numānena anumānasiddho'pi ayam iti pratyakṣatā-dhyavasāyāt numānasaṃvādasamarthitārthamūlatālakṣaṇena pratibandhena pramāṇaphalāt pratyakṣapramāṇaka ity api na na yujyate vaktuṃ tena bāhyākāratayā saṃvedanarūpaprakāśavicchedena dhyavasāyāt adhyavasāyāpekṣatvācca pratyakṣavyavahārasya cet iti nipāto bāhyārthavādinā saṃbhāvyamānatāṃ āha avicitrāt vicitro'yaṃ tattad iti ya uktaḥ ākasmiko nirbhāsamānabodhahetukatvāsaṃbhavād ajñātahetukaḥ ābhāsaḥ sa bāhyam anupāyatīti saṃbhāvyate avicitrāt bodhāt kramika ābhāsabhedo yuktaḥ tata ekāntena bāhya eva hetutayā anumīyate iti yadi paro manyeteti sutrārthaḥ avatārayati etat cet ityasya vyākhyānaṃ bhāvisūtrārthaparyantasparśi vyākhyeyam tattad iti vyākhyātam kramaśabdena ākasmikatvam svasāmarthyayogāt yugapat vicitraṃ kāryam ullāsayet nāma kramasya tu na hetuḥ saṃbhāvyate iti hiśabdena dvitīyārdhaṃ hetutayā sūtre sūcitam hetunā ca pūrvasiddhena bhāvyam ityāśayena upeyopakramocitapravṛttike'pi sūtre vṛttau pūrvaṃ vyākhyātaṃ tasyāviśeṣe'pi ityantena tathaiva vivṛtikāro'pi vyācaṣṭe ajñātahetukatvena ākasmikatāṃ vyācakṣāṇo bāhyasya anumeyatāṃ sūcayati anumeyabāhyārthavādī nirbhāsamāne bodhe sākāre prakṛtaśāstrārthābhyupagamasabrahmacārī iti darśayati jaḍatvam iha paraprasiddhyapekṣayā pramukhe mantavyam yadāha vedyatvāt iti arthakriyāsaṃvādapratilabdha satyabhāvābhāvā bāhyāḥ ta eva ābhāsānāṃ viṣayavyavasthāniyatasvabhāvānāṃ bodhānāṃ krameṇa udbhavatāṃ ekasāmagrīrūpatānupātena hetavo bhaviṣyantīti dharmottarīyam āśaṃkya āha uktaṃyāyena iti pūrvasūtradvaye pratyakṣameva prakāśātmakam aprakāśarūpabhāvane kathaṃ syāt iti uktam yadāha ācāryadharmottaraḥ anubhavasiddho bāhyasya bhedaḥ yastu abhedaḥ sa tatra anubhavamātreṇa jñānasya sadṛśātmanā bhāvyaṃ tenātmanā yena pratikarma vibhajyate iti yuktibalena vyavasthāpyamāno nānubhavika iti tad ayuktīkṛtam na bhinnasya iti vadati vijñānavādini tasya tādātmyāt tathā prathanaṃ na tadanyasya kasyacit iti nītyā anubhavasiddho bheda iti tata eva sātāsātayor vyāvṛttimātrakalpito na bhedaḥ pṛthagākārānanubhave hi tathā syāt ihatu pṛthagākāropalambha ity api asat saṃvedanatādātmyenaiva upalambhasya uktatvāt pratikarmavyavasthā api svasaṃvedanātmakasākṣātkārasvabhāvaiva nīlam idaṃ saṃvedyate pītam idaṃ saṃvedyate ity evaṃrūpā kevalaṃ vipratipadyamānasya hetucchāyayā nirdiṣṭā ghaṭo'yaṃ pratyakṣasiddhatvād astītivat anānubhavikatvam uktam vyavahārasya mūlāpabādhanasāmarthyaviraha iti hi asakṛd uktam vyāmūḍhapratyakṣameva pratyakṣam apitu parīkṣakavedyam ity api bhaṭṭena uktam dṛḍhānumānasiddham api ca kiṃ na siddhaṃ bhavatīti alamasthānasvadarśanapakṣapatanena parasya ghaṭasya prakāśamānataiva rūpaṃ tathā ghaṭatā api bhaviṣyati nīlasya iva kṣaṇikatvakāryatvakāraṇatvādi ityāśaṃkya āha atra hetuḥ prakāśatvādabhyadhiko hi ghaṭāṃśo prakāśasvabhāvaḥ syāt nīlameva tu bhūtvā na bhavaddhetor udbhavat svāmarthakriyāṃ vidadhacca atadvyāvṛttikalpitair bhāvāntarasādhāraṇaiḥ kṣaṇikatvādibhiḥ avibhaktam avadhāryatāṃ kāmaṃ natu parasparābhāvavyāpta nīlapītatādātmyam ekasya yuktam ghaṭasya svabhāva iti na asau prakāśena ekātmā ekātmatve vyāpako virodhābhāvas tadviruddhaśca virodha iha upalabhyate iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiḥ na viruddho nīlātmā prakāśānadhikatvāt prakāśa iti cet pītaprakāśatā na kadācit upapadyeta nīlasya pītāt bhedāt prakāśa iti cet yugapadeva tathā nirbhāseta nīlapītādivaiśvarūpyabhāg iti cet svāpādau prakāśarūpatā na syāt samastanīlādirūpatāśūnyasya upalabdhiprakāśamātreṇa śuddhena vapuṣā pratilabdho bodhena svabhāva iti tadadhikaṃ yadatra kiṃcit nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā śvetaṃ vā sātaṃ vā asātaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ prakāśādadhikaṃ aprakāśarūpameveti virodham āpādayet kramaniyamo'pi asti śuddhabodharūpānantaraṃ nīlābhāsaḥ tataḥ samanantarapratyayāt pītābhāsa ityādir vaicityasahasrāṇāṃ darśanād aniyamena ca kāryakāraṇatvāyogād iti yuktamuktaṃ viruddhadharmādhyāsena iti

vṛttāv evakāreṇa dyotyam yato vijñānaśarīrībhūtasya ghaṭāder ākārasya saṃvedanarūpād adhikaṃ tṛṇamātram api rūpaṃ na asti tataḥ sthūlatāyāḥ kasyāścit paramārthasatyā abhāvāt kim avalambya codyaṃ kriyeta sthūlaṃ hi deśavitataṃ bhinnadeśaṃ ca naca ekameva taddeśamataddeśaṃ ca bhavitumarhatīti sthūlaṃ kiṃcana vastu yadevaṃ paryanuyogapātrīkriyeta yo jñānasya upādhir jñānatādātmyena nirbhāsamāno nīlādiḥ sa vijñānāt yato bhedena aśakyadarśanaḥ tato nanyabhāk san pītādiviviktaḥ san naśakyadarśana iti na anyat rūpaṃ tato jñānāt vyatiriktavikalpavedyaṃ vyatiriktaṃ bhajate pṛthagbhāvena ekānekatādinā arthe vibhramakalpitabāhyabhāve nipatati taccitrākārasvasaṃvedanāstamayasamuditavikalpakāle vivecako yena kathaṃ tadeva nīlaṃ tadeva pītam ityādi paryanuyogaprāṇitena citraṃ tadekam iti ced idaṃ citrataraṃ tataḥ ity evamādi vācyatāśatonmeṣeṇa artham upalabhate na vijñānasya ākārībhūte kaścit viveko yena codyā śaṃkā syāt ekameva sthūlākāraṃ katham iti bāhyaṃ tu na sthūlākāram upapadyate tadeva ca dṛśyate pratibhāsadharmaḥ sthulateti ca bāhyārthāpahnavapūrvaraṃga eva ayam ity api bāhyānupapattisūtre parākariṣyate bodhasya rūpaṃ na prakāśādatiricyate kiṃcit etadeva apiśabdena āha ahaṃkārāspadabhūto bodhaḥ samādhānāvasthāpratipanno vā ekābhāsaniṣṭho vā na yatra bodhādhikarūpāntarasaṃbhavāśaṃkā kācit citrākāre'pi yāvad eṣaiva vārtā bodhakarūpatvena iti virodhāpekṣayā api tṛtīyā vyākhyeyā hetau mukhyatayā prayuktā api yathā darpaṇena na gajaturagayor virodho nāpi tayor anyonyaṃ darpaṇaikaparamārthatvāt tathā bodhena na nīlapītayor anyonyaṃ bodhaikaparamārthatvād iti anumānena itthaṃ saugataḥ samarthayitum adhyavasitaḥ naca ayamekameva bodham icchati tat kā iyaṃ granthaśayyā sā iyaṃ granthaśayyā bāhye'rthe sati deśakālabhinne tajjanitāni saṃvedanāni ākāravanti kāraṇabhedāt bhinnānīti yuktam tatra tu sati bodhaikarūpatā pareṇa ānīyamānā aparihāryaiveti vijñānavādī sarvathā samastadarśanāpabādhakaḥ iti ākūtena bāhyārthavādī ekabodhādvayavādam āpatantam asya darśayati indranīlaḥ padmarāga indukānta iti maṇer viśeṣā maṇirūpānadhikāḥ kasyacid api atra amaṇitvāyogāt yathāca śāvaleyo bāhuleyaḥ khaṇḍa iti gotvasya viśeṣās indriyavadeva tarhi kāraṇamātraṃ tat kiṃcit syāt nīlaṃ, pītam ityādi tu kutaḥ atra ucyate pratyakṣapratītiḥ tasyā yā pariniṣṭhā paśyāmīty adhyavasāyarūpā tasyā aviṣayatvena tad api avaseyatvena kalpyate natu kāraṇamātratayā yato'rthatvena ayam iti tatra adhyavasāyaḥ viśeṣaṃ darśayitum āha indriyajanitānāṃ jñānānāṃ pratyakṣasaṃvedanarūpāṇāṃ satyam indriyaṃ kāraṇaṃ natu viṣayas tairjñānena indriyaṃ paśyāmīty adhyavasāyasya ajananāt anumānasyaiva viṣayas tadadhyavasāyenaiva adhyavasitatvāt anumānaṃ ca viṣayo yasya ananyatrabhāvo viṣayārthaḥ iha punaḥ iti prakṛte viśeṣam āha kathaṃ dṛṣṭatvena avasita iti ced āha yāvat kiṃcit deśakālasahacāri svarūpavaicitryaṃ jñānāntavṛttenīrlasya tāvat sarvamavikalaṃ tadarpakasyeti sāmānābhihāramelananyāyena jñānīyākāraviṣayo'dhyavasāya utpannaḥ sārūpyakṛtāt vibhramāt jñānabhinnamarthākāram idantocitam adhyavasyāmi ity evam upajāyate na ca asau vibhramajo'pi adhyavasāyo gṛhītāyāṃ śuktikāyāṃ rupyāvasāya iva gṛhīte jñānākāre bāhye avasāyatayā bhramamātrasvabhāvaḥ kintu arthapratibandhanāt maulikaṃ jñānākārārpaṇasamartham arthaṃ kāraṇabhūtam adhyavasyan bhrāntirapi saṃbandhaḥ pramā iti nyāyena pramāṇavyāpāratām ātmani ādarśayati yadāha arthasya saṃbhave bhāvāt pratyakṣe'pi pramāṇatā pratibaddhasvabhāvasya taddhetutve samaṃ dvayam iti darśanabalāt paśyāmīty evaṃ pratyakṣādinā adhyavasāyarūpatāṃ gṛhṇan pratyakṣam anugrāhakam arthasya amātya iva paravaśīkṛtaṃ rājānaṃ grāhakatvena vyavaharati tataḥ pratyakṣagṛhīta eva bāhyo'rtha iti laukikam anusṛtaṃ bhavati anumānasya kutra vyāpāraḥ āha mūlakāraṇabhūtaḥ samarpakaḥ ākārāṇām asti arthaḥ tadākārasadṛśa iti etāvati vyāpāro'numānasya yaditu anumānaṃ tamarthaṃ bāhyam adhyavasīyamānaṃ bādheta sthairyam iva sattvahetuḥ tad asau bāhyatādhyavasāyo nirmūla eva bhavann apramāṇaphalaṃ syād agṛhīte bāhye marīcigrahaṇe'pi jalāvasāyo bhavann agṛhītaviṣayo na pramāṇaphalam yadica anadhyavasitaṃ yathā kṣaṇikatvaṃ sattvahetuḥ prasādhayati tathā bāhyamarthaṃ pratibimbatvahetuḥ tat laukikaḥ pratyakṣadṛṣṭena arthena vyavahārākṣama iti na syādeva vyavahāraḥ āha indriyopayogena iti indriyaṃ upayujyate asmin vijñāne tena adhyavasāyāṅgīkāritabāhyārthaviṣayatākena anumānavyāpārāt ākasmikamahetukam iti prasiddhaṃ nākasmikā na nityāste na nityajñānahetukāḥ iti kāryākasmikatvaprasaṅga ityādau ahetukāt hetvanumānaṃ yuktam ity āśaṃkāṃ vyapohati kiṃśabdasya cicchabdanipātadyotitārthasahāyasya viśeṣo'rthaḥ kaścid iti nañsamāse taddhitavṛttau ca dadhyodanamārdaṅgikādigata iti vyavatiṣṭhate viśeṣaviśrāntiśūnyasya avadhibhāvāt viśeṣasya avaśyaṃbhāve sāmānyādāgata iti vacanavyaktir ajñātaviśeṣāditīyati paritiṣṭhati ākasmiko'yamartha ityukter ajñātahetūdbhavatvaṃ nañtaddhitavṛttitātparyāyāto vākyārhte padavacanaṃ śrotrendriyakṣetriyavat iti nayena mukhyo'rthaḥ sati ca hetau yathā bhavati ajñānaṃ tathā asatyapi iti ajñānasādharmyād ahetukābhidhāyī sādṛśyanimittatayā lakṣaṇayā tatra tatra prayuktaḥ natu iha tatheti yuktamuktam ākasmikādajñātahetor aniyatakramakatayā kramikādābhāsavaicitryāt bāhyārthasiddhir iti svatantrasvākāravijñānasamarthanarabhasapravṛttatvavaśyamapraśa-manīyam īśvarādvayavādaṃ samastasvanikāyasamayonmūlanam anupraveśayiṣyati iti sūtravṛttivivṛtīnāṃ tātparyam

sa eva bāhyārthavādī āśaṃkya niṣedhayati na vāsanāprabodho'tra vicitro tasyāpi tatprabodhasya vaicitrye nibandhanam anādikālopanatānām yo vicitraḥ
prabodhaḥ sa eva atra kramikābhāsavaicitrye hetutāmeti prathamataḥ caramaṃ tu prabodho iti vijñānavādī saṃbhāvayate dūṣayati atra hetumāha yo'sau vicitratvena saṃmato sa svātmani vaicityāt vā vicitraḥ vāsanāvicitrabhāvāt vā prabodhakabhedāt vā yato vāsanā nāma vijñānānatiriktavigrahā tat punar api prabodhamātram ekam anyasya asattvāt prabodhe'pi vācyam naca prabodhakahetavo'pi vijñānabāhyāḥ kecana upapadyante sarvasya prakāśamānasya ābhāsavaicitryam anyato na ghaṭate iti samarpakena ābhāsavaicitryādhāyinā bāhyenaiva bhavituṃ yuktam iti cet iti sūtrārthaḥ spaṣṭaḥ taṃ saṃkṣipya avatārayati vāsanāprabodhavaicitryasya vāsanāṃ kastūrikākalpitavastrādyadhivāsavat satataṃ vyākhyātuṃ tasyāḥ śaktirūpatām abhidhatte śaktimadekaparamārthatāsiddhaye bodha ityādinā prabodhaṃ vyācaṣṭe etad iti nīlapītādikramikābhāsalakṣaṇaṃ yat svakāryaṃ tajjanane kartavya ābhimukhyaṃ paripāko ntyāvasthāprāptatayā sa prabodhaḥ vāsanāsmṛtijanakaḥ saṃskāraḥ prasiddhaḥ natu apūrvānubhavaprasādhaka iti tāvat na udgrāhayāmahe sāṃnyāsikam etad avatiṣṭhatāmiti bhāvaḥ adhikasya aprakāśatvena bodhaśarīrānuveśayogyatāvirahād iti hi uktaṃ bhavadbhireva nijavratam śabdaḥ kevalam adhikībhavet prabuddhavāsano bodha iti natu arthaleśaḥ uktaivaṃvidhaviśeṣāntaro'pītyarthaḥ ābhāsavaicitryaṃ kāryatvena samarthanīyaṃ tad api bodhāt manāg api na atiriktam aprakāśanaprasaṃgāt atiriktam ivaca bhāti tad asya evaṃvidhasya kāryasya yādṛśo yakṣastādṛśo baliḥ ityupapattyā kāraṇam api vāsanāprabodhavaicitryaṃ paramārthato bodhānatiriktam api atiriktāyamānaṃ bhaviṣyati iti kim idam nahi kāryavaicitryam api pāramārthikaṃ kiṃcana yasya anupapattir yatna pariharaṇīyā bhavet na sahate etat iti vakṣyamāṇam darśayati na ityatra upapattim āha kāryaṃ hi apūrvatayā bhāsamānam ucyate tacca vastu vā astu svārthakriyāyogāt viparyayādavastu vā satyarajatābhāsavat sudhāśakalarajatābhāsavacca kāraṇaṃ punaḥ kāraṇatvādeva samartham arthakriyālakṣaṇatvāt vastuna iti vastveva bhavitumarhati na avastu sarvasāmarthyavirahalakṣaṇatvādeva avastunaḥ kāraṇatā niṣidhyate vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhyā abodharūpatayā ca vastutvam na vicitram iti kutaḥ kāryavaicitryam tadāha bodhatayā vasturūpasya ityarthaḥ nīlavāsanāprabodhavān bodhaḥ pītavāsanāprabodhavān bodha ityādinā vicitraḥ tadrūpaṃ nīlapītādibhedam āyatate sa ca bhrānta iti tad api avastu sat bodhasya kathaṃ satyaṃ vicitrabhāvam ānayet satyena vicitrabhāvena kāryavaicitryam apāramārthikaṃ tadvat kāraṇavaicitryam api bhaviṣyati ityāśayena śaṅkate etadeva pūrvamuktam ābhāsabhede'pi ityādinā kintu tatra itthamuktam kārye'pi nīlādyābhāsavarge bodharūpameva pāramārthikaṃ kāraṇe'pi tadeveti pāramārthikatāmukhena sāmyam ānītam adhunā tu apāramārthikatā vaicitryaviṣayā dvayor api iti bhaṃgyantareṇeti apunaruktam na sahate hetum āha tadabhyupagame iti kāraṇatvāṅgīkaraṇe iha iti nīlādyābhāsakrame nahi iti kāryaṃ yathā dṛṣṭamātraṃ paścād iti arthāt labhyate na tathā pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭamātre kāraṇam iti vaidharmyeṇa pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭam itīyadeva kāraṇasya lakṣaṇam āha pūrvadṛṣṭamātrasya apihi kāraṇatvam etadeva yat vastunaḥ satyasya avastuno vā asatyasya prakhyāpane samarthatā saiva ca vastutvam kārym avastu tarhi asya kathaṃ kāryatā kā khalu asyāḥ kṣatiḥ avastutvena tasya sāmarthyaṃ nijaṃ kāryāntaramakurvataḥ kāraṇatā na syāt etad āha kāryasya sāmarthyavirahe tu iti tat viśiṣṭakāraṇabalotpannaṃ katham avastu bhavet avastutve vā tatpadabandhapratilabdhasāmarthyaṃ kāraṇasya na kiṃcit sāmarthyam iti kāraṇam api avastu bhavet etad api anenaiva āha avastutvāt kāryasya kāraṇe kāraṇatvaṃ na bhavet kāryāpekṣasya sāmarthyasya abhāvād iti ityarthaḥ kāryatāyāstu avastutvaṃ na uparodhakam avastuno hi kāryataiva na bhavet yadi satkāryavāda iva svāt sāmarthyāt tad udbhavet naca evam kāryaṃ hi avastubhūtameva utthāpyate kāraṇena tadaivaca tat kāryam ucyate yadā nirupākhyam darśitaṃ ca svasāmarthyena iti vadatā kāryagatabhavanam na kutracidupayogi yadaṃgīkṛtam anyaiḥ nityaṃ na bhavanaṃ yasya ... iti tat kāryam asadeva kāraṇabalādudbhūtaṃ yadi sarvātmanā sāmarthyayuktaṃ tat vastu na cet avastu bodharūpatvena vastvātmānaḥ satyaḥ kāryā eva dvicandrajñānam iva timirasya dvicandrasya tu arthakriyāvirahād avastutvam astu na tatsaṃvedanasya saṃvedanāntarāt vicitrasya tadāha kāmalayā pītaśaṃkhasaṃvit kācena kācaśaṃkhapratyayas timireṇa śaṃkhadvayasaṃvit iti hi dṛśyate eva pratītirūpaṃ bhrāntau kāryaṃ tarhi pratīter vastutvāt kathamuktaṃ kāryatvaṃ punar avastutve'pīti dvicandrādi avastu tadeva kāryaṃ tarhi kāraṇavyāpārabalotpannaṃ katham avastu tanniṣṭhena vāsāmarthyena kathaṃ kāraṇaṃ vastu bhavet ity āśaṃkya āha etaduktaṃ bhavati kāraṇatvacintāyāṃ bodhasya avaśyaṃ pāramārthikasvarūpasamāveśamātra eva avastheyam ity evaṃparatvena asmābhir abhihitam adaḥ bodharūpatvaṃ ca pāramārthikaṃ ca tacca avicitraṃ bhaṅgyantarasahasre'pi yojyamāne tat hi na pāramārthikaṃ kiṃcit prakāśādhikasya aprakāśanaprasaṃgād iti hi paramaṃ vratam iheyam āgamato yuktitaśca darśayati nīlavāsanāprabodhasya bodhādanarthānantaratvāt pītavāsanāprabodhavatā bodhena tulya eva asau bodhaḥ so'pi teneti bodhamātramekameva iti piṇḍārthaḥ

vastutattvam abhidhāya āha pūrvaṃ nīlavāsanāprabodhe pītavāsanāprabodhe'pi ca bodharūpam ekam iti uktam mā bhūt vā tadvāsanādvayaprayogāt kintu pītavāsanāprabodhāt tadvāsanāvaśena bhedo vaktavyaḥ nīlapītayośca kathaṃ bhedaḥ cakrakameva tadbheda iti cet karmabhede'pi nimittaṃ vaktavyam saṃskārarūpatayā sthitād iti cet bodhatātiriktā nīlābhāsatā kutaḥ prāthamiko nīlābhāsaḥ kasmāt sarvaprathamanīlarūpatāpratilambhe nidānaṃ vācyam kramikanīlapītādyābhāsasvabhāva evaca bodha iti svāpamūrchāsamādhānādau śuddhātmatā tasya katham sāpi nīlapītādyābhāsavad asya svabhāva iti cet na śuddhāśuddhātmatvayor virodhād iti uktaprāyam śavalasvabhāvatve bodhasya aṅgīkṛte nirmokṣaprasaṃgaḥ tataśca prabhāsvaram idaṃ cittaṃ prakṛtyā āgantavo malāḥ iti prajñāpāramitādvaitaṃ jñānam ... iti yāmadvayajñānamayīm ... ityādeḥ svagamābhyupagamāder vipralopaḥ iti alam sidhyati yadi bodharūpatātiriktam anādi nijanijabāhyakāraṇaparamparāprabhavaṃ bāhyameva kiṃcit vastu bhavet iti bāhyārthavādinā svapakṣaḥ pratyujjīvitaḥ āha svasantānavarti saṃbhāvyamānaṃ tāvat kāraṇaṃ karmādhipatyaṃ pūrvo nīlābhāsaḥ samanantarapratyayaḥ pītābhāsaprāya ity etadāśaṃkitaṃ nīlapītādikramikābhāsavaicitrye naca tad upapadyate iti uktam parasantānavarti vaicitryaṃ nīlādyābhāsavaicitryakrame adhipatipratyayarūpatayā hetur iti yaḥ śaṃketa taṃ prati āha bāhyārthavādī parapramātṛrūpāṇi yāni bodhāntarāṇi ābhāsavaicitryodbhāvanakāraṇabhāvena samarthayitum iṣyante teṣāṃ saṃpādayitavyābhāsabhedāt tasmāt bodhasantānādekasmāt bhede sati kāraṇatā saṃbhāvyate sa evatu katham bodhasya tāvat svarūpaṃ nityam aham iti antarmukham idantāvabhāsavaśa samuditabhinnakakṣyau deśakālau tadbodhaviśeṣaṇabhāvābhigamanāsamarthau na bhindāte iti asakṛt uktam anyatarasya aprakāśarūpatvād abodhatvam āpated iti na deśato na kālato vibheditā asti saṃvidaḥ svarūpato'pi bheditā jaḍāt na saṃvidaścitaḥ vastutaḥ pramātrantarāsiddhiḥ abhyupagamavāde tu sadā sannihitāni khalu parapramātrantarāṇi tāni ca ābhāsavaicityaśatasahasravarti yaugapadyād ekasminneva kṣaṇe tataśca ekaikatra santāne tadekavyatirikta samastasaṃbuddhāsaṃbuddha-pramātrantaragatā bhāsavaicityāṇi kāraṇabhāvam upagatānīti na kaścit niyamena kvāpi pramātari ābhāsabhedaḥ samarthayituṃ śakyate iti koṭidhā upaplavahetur samarthanaprakāraḥ āha

jaḍābhimataṃ bhāvābhāsajātam indhanāgnyābhāsa bījabhūsalilābhāsādi cetanaiḥ parasparayogyadeśasaṃnidhāpanābhidhānopasarpaṇasaṃpādana-samarthaiḥ pratyayairhetubhir nijanijakāryasaṃpādanocitayogya-deśasaṃnihitaṃ tāvat kriyate iti na asti atra vivādaḥ cetanāśca icchāvantaḥ sāca icchā layavijñānakalpāraghaṭṭaghaṭīyantravāhakecchā iva anantakālabhāviniyatakramakam ābhāsavaicitryam āgūryaiva uttiṣṭhati pararāṣṭramardanāvaluṇṭhanabhaṅga-bhedanaprabhṛti ābhāsāntaraśatasahasrābhisandhānagarbhatayaiva prādurbhavati prabandhena prayuktamābhāsapadaṃ vijñānanaye bāhyārthābhāvāt vijñānākārataiva upasarpaṇapratyayādīnāṃ pūrvapūrvarūpatayā kāraṇānāṃ uttarottaraṃ ca kāryāṇām iti sūcayati yasmād uttarottaratayā niyamavatyā kāryatvena abhimatāḥ abhimānena tathā niścitāḥ pūrvatāniyamāt ca kāraṇatvena abhimatā ābhāsabhedāḥ kriyante svenaiva icchāviśeṣeṇa vijñānarūpeṇa tathā iti tato hetuprakārādi idamāyātam yat kila icchākhyālayavijñānaviśeṣasamutthāpito yaḥ ādyaḥ kāraṇābhāso yathā grāmaprāptyabhisandhānātmavijñānotthayā gamanecchayā utthitaḥ śarīrābhāsaḥ sa eva madhyavartino mārgābhāsaṃ tadvartinaśca tṛṇādinīlādyābhāsān ākṣipati yāvad grāmapraptyābhāsaphalam tato'pi tṛptyābhāsātmakaphalāntarābhisandhānodbhūtayā icchayā yaḥ pākābhāsaḥ prathamakāraṇābhimataḥ utthāpitaḥ tenaiva adhiśrayaṇādyābhāso ntyagrāsanigaraṇābhāsaparyantaḥ ākṣiptaḥ tataḥ pānagoṣṭhīvaicityābhāseccha ityādi mantavyam kimanena bahutarecchāprabandhākṣepiṇā bhūyasā kāryakāraṇabhāvena parikalpitena ekapraghaṭṭakasaṃmurchita eva yaḥ karmavallīpratānābhāsaḥ ekalayavijñānarūpaḥ sa eva maraṇakṣaṇaparyantābhāsāvadhīn niyatakramabhāvinaḥ sukhaduḥkhatatsādhanābhāsān ākṣipati punarjanmāntare'pi evaṃ natu teṣāmābhāsānāṃ madhyavartināṃ punaḥ kāraṇāntaram upayujyate yathā pātayāmi enaṃ giriśikharād iti anayaiva icchayā pātyamānasya gata tattaddeśasaṃyogavibhāgatatkṛtaduḥkhamohādyābhāsa-paramparā ākṣiptaiva tata eva madhye sā aśakyapratibandhā yadāha muniḥ iha te karmaṇāmeva vipākaś cintayiṣyati amutra bhavitā yatte taccintaya śubhāśubham iti madhyābhāsānāṃ aśakyapratibandhatvaṃ vadatā karmābhāsākṣepāvinābhāva eva uktaḥ prārabdhrekaṃ na śodhayet iti aśakyatvameva uktamāgame yenedaṃ taddhi bhogataḥ iti ca lagnaviśeṣarūpāt kṣaṇābhāsāt sarvaṃ tajjātakagaṇanākāle maraṇakṣaṇāntaṃ niścinvanti yāvad tajjanmagatamaraṇakṣaṇalagnaviśeṣābhāsāt janmāntarābhāsākṣepādi niravadhi apavargāvadhikaṃ vā gaṇyate eva niyatakramānurodhina ābhāsaprabandhasya ekaṃ kāraṇam iti apūrvam adaḥ apitu bālyādau grahanakṣatrādyudayāstamayaparamparāprabandhe ṛtusamudāye ca pratītatarameveti darśayati yathā iti niyataṃ kālam avasthātuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ vicitrāṇāṃ vilakṣaṇānām anyonyato niyato yaḥ prabandha uttarottaratvena ābhāsaparamparā tasyā ekameva kiṃcit hetur iti iti iti pūrvakriyayā abhisaṃbadhyate sarvasmin naitad upapadyate kṛttikodayādinā nirūpite grahanakṣatrarāśiparispande tāvad etad upapadyate ṛtvādau ca yatra niyata eva kramaḥ bālyayauvanādau tu na naiyatyam asti avaśyaṃbhāvinaḥ kramasya anyathāca anyathāca avalokanāt madhyavartinām āhāravaicityādīnāṃ yauvanajarāsaṃpādanatāratamyabhājām adhvagamanādeśca jarāsamutthāpakasya rasopayogādeśca yauvanaparirakṣaṇaikakasakṣaṇasya svaniyatabhāvitayā pūrvakarmamātrakṛtamākṣepam asahamānasya kāraṇabhāvena vartamānasya katham apahnavaḥ kriyeta madhyavartinaḥ kāraṇavaicitryam anyad upalabhyate tataśca samanantarābhāsasyaiva tatra kāraṇatvam iti na tāvad ādyasyaiva hetutā

kimanena puruṣaviśeṣagatena bālyādinā puruṣasāmānyāpekṣayā bālyādikam asmābhiḥ udāhṛtatam iti ityatra vastuni idam api na upapannaṃ tatrāpi prathamakāraṇākṣiptatvābhāvāt yathā prabhāsvarād apavarakapraviṣṭasya na prathamakāraṇabalādeva cakṣurādīnām ālocanahetūnāṃ saṃpattiḥ tathātve hi praviṣṭamātrasyaiva apavarakodarāntarvartisamastavastvavalokanaṃ saṃpadyeta apitu paramparāpekṣāto'tra cakṣurādīnāṃ viśeṣapratilambharūpaḥ pariṇāmaviśeṣo apekṣyaḥ bījabhūmyudakānāṃ aṅkure janayitavye paramparāsaṃnidhānajanito tiśayarūpaḥ pariṇāmaviśeṣaḥ yathāca odanasaṃpattau kartavyāyāṃ sthālītaṇḍulodakānām anyathā pariṇāmāntarānapekṣāyāṃ jhaḍityeva aṅkura odanaśca jāyeta sāmagryā hi tatra pūrṇatvam tatra hi na adhikam anupraveśayitavyaṃ nāpi tataḥ kiṃcid apasārayitavyam kramasaṃnihitānām ādityacandrādyudayānāṃ ca nīhāravihārādīnāṃ ca avaśyaṃ paramparopakārapariṇāmena bhavitavyam anyathā katipayakṣaṇaireva bālyāt yauvanaṃ tato'pi madhyamavayaḥ tato'pi vārdhakam iti savidhavartyeva nidhanaṃ syāt asti tu kālāntarapratīkṣaṇam madhye sajātīyaśarīraparamparāsvabhāvena pūrvāvasthāpracyāvottarāvasthodayaśūnyena api dehasantānena kaṃcitkālam avastheyam tadāha jātakagaṇane'pi na iha dine idamidaṃ drakṣyati sprakṣyati vakṣyatīti pratipadaṃ hasitakaṇḍūyitaparyantavyāparasaṃvedanasaṃbhavaḥ apitu sukhaduḥkhāveśopayogidaśāviśeṣasaṃvedanamātraṃ bhavati anyathā ekajātakatattvasaṃvedane tallagnatayā sarvaṃ vidyāt bālyādau prathamakāraṇākṣiptatvaṃ tāvad asat vaicityaśatadarśanāt aragh aṭṭaghaṭīyantravāhane tu tāsāṃ ghaṭīnāṃ bharaṇāvarjanaparivartanādāv avicitra eva kramaḥ sarvadā tatrāpi vaicitryaṃ ced avaśyaṃ sahakāryantaram antarā syāt nīlādyābhāsavaicitrye yauvanādau rasāyanādyupayoga iva sahakāryantarapraveśaḥ kaścit niyatasya sahakāriṇo navalokanāt rasāyanopayogāt yauvanaṃ avatiṣṭhate ciraṃ kālaṃ gatam apivā punar navopayoga iva punarāvartate iti niścito'tra sahakārī tathā nīlābhāse sthire vā asthire vā astameti punarudbhavati vā ayaṃ sahakārī iti na niścayo'sti prabhāsvarādapavarakapraveśa iva anyonyapariṇāmāpekṣā sā hi tatra bhavet yatra niyataḥ kālāntarapratīkṣāyogo bhāsate iha tu nīlābhāsakṣaṇamātrasamanantaram api pītābhāso dṛṣṭa eva na yuktā kramaniyamasya abhāvāt pūrvoktaṃ smārayati ubhayatrāpi iti saṃbhāvyamāne iti bhāvaḥ icchātmakaḥ prathamahetur yaḥ prāguktaḥ prathamecchayaiva hetvavabhāso'ntarākṣipta ityādinā tadākṣiptatāyāṃ kramaniyamābhāvam āha anyadā iti tasyaiva puruṣasya puruṣāntarasya vā iti tajjātīyāt hi kāraṇāt tajjātīyameva kāryaṃ bhavati iti yuktam iha ca icchāyā tasminneva puṃsi pumantare vā vahnimutpādayāmi ity evaṃrūpeṇa tajjātīyatāyām avikalāyām api antarāsamudbhavato nīlapītādyābhāsakramasya niyamena tajjātīyatvam yo dvitīyaḥ prathamahetuḥ saṃbhāvitaḥ pūrvakarmabhirevavā ityādinā tatra kramaniyamābhāvo ya āpādayitumiṣyate bāhyārthavādinā sa ekapuruṣāpekṣayā na upapannaḥ ekasmin janmani prathamakarmapraghaṭṭakahetvākṣipte tasya ekasyaiva nīlādyābhāsakramasya maraṇābhāsāntasya bhāvād ityāśayena puruṣāntarāpekṣayā taṃ kramaniyamābhāvam āha bahuvacanena śarīrādyābhāsavargasya prathamakāryasya sarvapuruṣeṣu tajjātīyatāvalokanāt pūrvakarṇo'pi tajjātīyatvakhaṇḍitaṃ siddham iti tajjātīyāt prathamahetos tajjātīyenaiva niyatakrameṇa nīlādyābhāsaprabandhena bhavituṃ yuktam iti abhiprāyaḥ ayuktaṃ sarvasya sukhaduḥkhābhāsaphalatvāyogāt dharmādharmayośca tatsādhanasaṃpādanopayogena prasiddhatvāt yadāha te hlādaparitāpaphalāḥ puṇyāpuṇyahetutvāt iti mārgagatatṛṇādidarśanam api paramparayā kayācid avaśyaṃ sukhaduḥkhayor vyāpriyate adṛṣṭeśvarādivādimate sarvasya tadaniṣṭānāviṣṭasya utpattyanabhyupagamāt tathāpi karmaiva ekaṃ prathamahetur iti yo manyate tasya etat dūṣaṇaṃ sākṣāt yat na sukhāya na vā tasya kathaṃ karmākṣiptatvam iti anyeṣāṃ tu bahutarahetuvādināṃ sāmagryā vaicityreṇa karmaṇo'pi ativicitratve sukhaduḥkhasādhanānām api vyavadhānāvyavadhānādibahutaracitrabhāvābhyupagamo na duṣyatīti

icchā eva ādyā nīlādyābhāsavaicitrye prathamahetuḥ pūrvakarma vā svakāraṇābhāsa eva tatra tatra kāryābhāse prathamahetur bhaviṣyati so'pi jaḍo vā anyo vā yo'sāv upasarpaṇapratyaya uktaḥ iti evaṃ prathamahetavo bhūyāṃsaḥ ābhāsavaicitryaṃ madhyavarti samutthāpayiṣyanti iti yasya matiḥ taṃ vitatya apahastitamohaṃ karoti abhisandhānam asti ityantena athavā pūrvaśeṣatayaiva asya granthasya ittham avatāraṇam bālyādau prathamahetukarmākṣipte'pi rasāyanopayogādinā sahakāriṇā yauvanam aticirakālam avatiṣṭhate tathā iha api sahakārivaśāt te te ābhāsāḥ ciram avasthāsyante tathāhi ghaṭābhāsasya anuvartane mṛddaṇḍādyābhāso hetuḥ dhūmābhāsasya vahnīndhanādisāmagryābhāsaḥ paṭābhāsasya kuvindaturivemādyābhāsaḥ evam anyatra vācyam dūṣayati atra hetuḥ antarā madhye avalokane gṛhavartino ghaṭapaṭābhāsāder mṛtpiṇḍadaṇḍādyābhāsasya nāma api na avaśiṣyate tāvat prathamaṃ mṛtpiṇḍābhāsaḥ saṃvedya eva tato'pi yas tadgṛhāt ghaṭam ānayati sa upasarpaṇapratyayābhāso gṛhavartino ghaṭābhāsasya anuvartane sahakārī bhaviṣyati astu yāvad āste svagṛhagate tu tasmin kaḥ sahakārī tadābhāsānuvṛtteḥ tadetadāha agnāvanumitsite dhūmābhāsasya dṛśyamānasya adṛśyamāno'pi tena anumātrā adṛśyamānatvādeva adhipatisāmyāt hetutvācca adhipatipratyayaśabdavācyo vahnyābhāsas taddeśakrimisarvajñādipramātṛniṣṭhatvena sthitaḥ hetuḥ evaṃ ghaṭaprāpako'pi puruṣaḥ svagṛhāvasthita eva atra sahakārī bhaviṣyati yadā tarhi sa yaśaḥśeṣībhūtaḥ tadā kiṃ kartavyam kaḥ sahakārī ghaṭābhāsasya avasthāne śaraṇīkartavyaḥ naṣṭasya na hetutvam anupākhyatvāt sopākhyatvaṃ hetutāyā vyāpakam tadviruddhasya ca iyam upalabdhiḥ krimisarvajñābhāsasya ca na hetutvam ādhipatyena anantābhāsodayaprasaṅgāt ityādi vakṣyate agrataḥ evam api yā hetutā ucyate sā na iti saṃbandhaḥ atra hetuḥ atraiva dṛṣṭāntam āha naṣṭasya kā hetutā yatra adhipatitvaṃ viśeṣo bhavet yato na asau dhūmābhāso gnyābhāsāt ato hetostādṛśāt dhūmābhāsajāt dhūmābhāsāt gopālaghaṭikāsaṃgṛhītavimuktāt na vahnyābhāsasya anumānam atatkāryatvāt yaduktaṃ tatra yadyapica ityādinā pūrvapakṣaṃ śaṃkitvā nirākaroti naitadyuktam ityanena yojyam etat rajakatakṣakalohakāraprabhṛtayaḥ vastutaḥ santi kvacid upapattisthānāntare'pi svarganarakādāv iti tathā kāryābhāsasiddhir na bhavatīti darśayati te tadā tadupasarpaṇapratyayatayā bhānti bhāsane ca tadābhāsakāraṇabhūta upasarpaṇapratyayāntarābhāsaḥ tatrāpi anyaḥ iti niravadhiḥ pūrvāvabhāso bhavet naca so'sti ityāha sarvajñasya tāvad ābhāsaparamparāpratibhāso asti iti tadvartinas te upasarpaṇapratyayābhāsāḥ dhūmānumeyahutavahābhāsa iva adhipatipratyayatvena asmadādiṣu kāṣṭhakuḍyādyābhāsabhedahetavaḥ santu iti tatra āha nahi samastatadupasarpaṇapratyayanirmita gṛharathaghaṭādyābhāsāḥ sarve sadā upalabhyante iti niyamo sti naca sahakāryantaraṃ tadupasarpaṇapratyayarūpapramātricchātmakasaṃvedanātiriktaṃ vijñānanaye yuktamupagamaṃ yena ayam aniyamas upapadyeta teṣām upapattisthānāntarabhājāṃ tadā tāvat na icchā adyāpi ābhāsantāṃ gṛhādaya iti pūrvanirmāṇāvasare'pi iyantaṃ samayam ete vābhāsantām iti na abhisandhānam eṣām abhisandhāne'pica madhya eva kīrtanasthānānāṃ maṭhādīnāṃ dhvaṃso dṛṣṭaḥ nacāpi te pūrvaṃ sarvajñā yena itthaṃ gṛhābhāso'sya ābhāsasya anantaro smāt pūrva etena vyavahita iti anantavaicitryam abhisandadhyuḥ nacāpi eteṣāṃ tāvān abhisandhir adyatanopasarpaṇapratyayāntareṣu tathādarśanābhāvāt iyatā prathamakāraṇākṣiptatā yato vitatya nirākṛtā tataḥ samanantarapratyayaparamparāta ābhāsavaicitryam iti āpatitaṃ gatyantaravirahāt tadapi ca ayuktam aniyamāt kumbhakārakulāvasthita ekaḥ pramātā antataḥ krimiḥ sarvajño vā avaśyam asti sa ca ghaṭābhāsarūpo jātas tāvat tatra ca asya hetur mṛddaṇḍakulālābhāsaḥ tato naṣṭe'pi tasmin tasya tāvat ghaṭābhāsādeva ghaṭābhāsa iti sthite yo'pi anyaḥ pramātā taddeśābhāsavān tasya api tadābhāsayogaḥ iti tatra api vivecyaṃ kiṃ pūrvasthitapramātrābhāsarūpa eva asau ghaṭābhāsaḥ kālāntarāgantukapramātrantarāntaranupraveśam eti ityetena nayena dvayos tāvati ābhāse aikātmyaṃ prāṇasukhaduḥkhādyābhāsabhede'pi utasvit pūrvasthitapramātrābhāsāt kāraṇād āgantukapramātṛvarty ābhāsāntarameva kāryarūpam udeti pūrvasmin kalpe tīrthikamatānuṣaṅgaḥ tathāhi dvayoḥ pūrvasthitāgantukayoḥ pramātror ekasaṃvedanarūpatābhyupagame viśeṣābhāvāt sarveṣāmekasaṃvidrūpatvād ekātmatā iti ekātmavādas tāvad aniṣṭaḥ tatrāpica ṛddhyantaram āyātam yat sa ekātmā svātantryāt saṃyojanaviyojane vicitre nirbhāsayan vicitraṃ pramātṛbhedam antarā antarā ca ābhāsāṃśe kvacana abhedam uparacayati iti maheśvararūpo'sāv iti ityāśayena bāhyārthavādī prathamapakṣaṃ dūṣayati atha
